overworld.name: Sargasso Drift
overworld.description: A dead calm region where engines fail and ships pile up in a graveyard of becalmed vessels. Stations are lashed-together hulks drifting in silence.

levels.name: The Lashing
levels.description: A makeshift dock of cables and welded gangplanks connecting dead freighters.
levels.theme: derelict cargo ships bound together with fraying cables, dim emergency lighting, floating debris

levels.name: Hull 17
levels.description: A hollowed-out colony ship repurposed as a trading post. The locals don't ask questions.
levels.theme: gutted colony ship interior, improvised market stalls, smuggler alcoves, stripped bulkheads

levels.name: The Doldrums
levels.description: The innermost ring of becalmed ships. Nothing moves here. The air tastes stale and wrong.
levels.theme: motionless ship graveyard, thick dust coating every surface, dead instrument panels, eerie stillness

levels.name: Engine Tomb
levels.description: A massive engineering bay where mechanics try to restart dead drives. None have succeeded.
levels.theme: cavernous engine room, failed reactor cores, scattered tools, desperate repair attempts

levels.name: The Becalmer
levels.description: The oldest ship in the drift. Something aboard it is generating the dead zone.
levels.theme: ancient vessel bridge, alien dampening field generators, pulsing unknown energy, warped hull plating

levels.name: Scavenger's Cache
levels.description: A hidden compartment deep in the drift where the best salvage is hoarded.
levels.theme: secret cargo hold, valuable salvage, booby traps, a collector's obsession

boss.name: Dockmaster Hale
boss.description: Charges tolls in blood. Rope-scarred hands.

weapon.name: Grappling Spike
weapon.description: A dock hook sharpened to a killing point.

armor.name: Lashed Plate Vest
armor.description: Hull scraps wired together. Heavy but reliable.

designs.victory_message: The cables go slack. The lashing drifts apart.
designs.defeat_message: You hang from the cables like another piece of salvage.

boss.name: Madame Carrion
boss.description: Runs the black market. Poisoned fingernails.

weapon.name: Shiv of Commerce
weapon.description: A broken credit chip honed to slice.

armor.name: Trader's Longcoat
armor.description: Lined with stolen hull composite. Surprisingly tough.

designs.victory_message: The market falls silent. Madame Carrion's ledger closes.
designs.defeat_message: Your name is added to the debtor's wall. Permanently.

boss.name: The Stillborn
boss.description: A fused navigator. Hasn't moved in years.

weapon.name: Petrified Baton
weapon.description: A calcified control rod. Hits like stone.

armor.name: Dust Cocoon
armor.description: Layered dust compressed into crude armor.

designs.victory_message: A breeze stirs for the first time in decades.
designs.defeat_message: You settle into the dust. Nothing moves again.

boss.name: Chief Ratchet
boss.description: Won't stop trying. Wrench fused to hand.

weapon.name: Plasma Torque Wrench
weapon.description: Meant for engines. Works on skulls.

armor.name: Mechanic's Blast Apron
armor.description: Scorched, oil-stained, practically indestructible.

designs.victory_message: The engine coughs once. Then silence. Then ignition.
designs.defeat_message: The engine stays dead. So do you.

boss.name: The Dampener
boss.description: Not a person. A field given hunger.

weapon.name: Momentum Lance
weapon.description: Stores kinetic energy. Releases it all at once.

armor.name: Faraday Shroud
armor.description: Woven conductive mesh. Grounds energy attacks.

designs.victory_message: The dead zone collapses. Engines roar to life across the drift.
designs.defeat_message: Your momentum stops. You float, forever still.

boss.name: Old Magpie
boss.description: Hoards everything. Trusts nothing. Shotgun loaded.

weapon.name: Magpie's Scattergun
weapon.description: Fires salvaged ball bearings. Messy but effective.

armor.name: Patchwork Carapace
armor.description: Every piece from a different ship. Ugly. Works.

designs.victory_message: The cache is open. Enough salvage to buy passage anywhere.
designs.defeat_message: Old Magpie adds your gear to the collection.

overworld.name: Kepler's Reach
overworld.description: Binary star research platforms orbiting twin suns. Prismatic interference paints everything in shifting spectra. Gravitational tides pull at the stations.

levels.name: Parallax Observatory
levels.description: The outermost research platform. Telescopes track the twin suns' dance.
levels.theme: observatory dome, refracted starlight, humming telescopes, prismatic lens arrays

levels.name: Spectral Lab
levels.description: Light analysis facility. Every surface refracts. Researchers went strange.
levels.theme: prism-filled corridors, rainbow caustics on walls, humming spectrometers, shattered lenses

levels.name: Tidal Lock Station
levels.description: Gravity research platform caught between both stars. Everything slides.
levels.theme: tilting corridors, sliding furniture, gravity flux zones, magnetic clamps on every surface

levels.name: Corona Bridge
levels.description: A shielded walkway passing through the binary stars' shared corona. Blinding heat.
levels.theme: heat-shielded tunnel, plasma viewing ports, melting insulation, solar wind vibration

levels.name: Barycenter Core
levels.description: The exact gravitational center between both suns. Reality bends here.
levels.theme: warped geometry, light bending around corners, temporal echoes, gravitational lensing

levels.name: Dark Companion
levels.description: A hidden third body orbiting the binary pair. It absorbs all spectra.
levels.theme: lightless corridors, absorption surfaces, spectrum-eating walls, inverse prisms

boss.name: Dr. Lux Parallax
boss.description: Stared into both suns. Sees too much.

weapon.name: Focused Beam Emitter
weapon.description: Concentrated starlight channeled through crystal.

armor.name: Anti-Glare Suit
armor.description: Polarized mesh. Dims incoming light attacks.

designs.victory_message: The telescopes go dark. Some things aren't meant to be watched.
designs.defeat_message: Both suns fill your vision. Then nothing.

boss.name: The Refractionalist
boss.description: Split into seven selves. Each a color.

weapon.name: Prism Shard Blade
weapon.description: Cuts along spectral lines. Wounds shimmer.

armor.name: Spectral Dampener Coat
armor.description: Absorbs stray wavelengths. Looks dull. Saves lives.

designs.victory_message: The spectrum collapses to white. The lab goes quiet.
designs.defeat_message: You refract. Seven pieces. None viable.

boss.name: Tidecaller Voss
boss.description: Controls local gravity. Walks on ceilings.

weapon.name: Grav-Hammer
weapon.description: Multiplies its own weight on impact.

armor.name: Mag-Lock Boots
armor.description: Stay grounded when everything else floats.

designs.victory_message: Gravity normalizes. Things stop sliding. Your stomach settles.
designs.defeat_message: You float into the tidal zone. Pulled apart gently.

boss.name: Solarch Krin
boss.description: Burns from within. Former station commander.

weapon.name: Sunspot Lance
weapon.description: A rod of captured solar plasma. Brief but brutal.

armor.name: Ablative Corona Shield
armor.description: Sheds layers to survive heat. Gets thinner.

designs.victory_message: The corona recedes. Temperature drops to merely unbearable.
designs.defeat_message: The bridge melts around you. A new sunspot.

boss.name: The Barycenter
boss.description: Not a person. A gravitational singularity. Aware.

weapon.name: Singularity Spike
weapon.description: A point of collapsed matter. Impossibly heavy.

armor.name: Geodesic Frame
armor.description: Bends space around you. Attacks curve away.

designs.victory_message: The center holds. Both suns resume their ancient dance.
designs.defeat_message: You orbit the barycenter forever. A new satellite.

boss.name: The Umbra
boss.description: Living darkness. Eats wavelengths. Whispers remain.

weapon.name: Blacklight Razor
weapon.description: Cuts with frequencies no eye can see.

armor.name: Emission Suit
armor.description: Generates its own light. The darkness hates it.

designs.victory_message: Light returns. The dark companion shrinks. Color floods back.
designs.defeat_message: The last photon in your suit goes out.

overworld.name: Dustbowl
overworld.description: An exhausted mining system picked clean decades ago. Ghost stations, desperate holdouts, and claim jumpers fighting over scraps in the dust.

levels.name: Assay Office
levels.description: The old claims office. Deeds to worthless rock. Someone's still filing.
levels.theme: dusty filing cabinets, faded mineral surveys, cracked assay scales, yellowed claim deeds

levels.name: Shaft 9
levels.description: A played-out mine. The holdouts say there's one vein left. They're lying to themselves.
levels.theme: collapsed tunnels, abandoned drills, empty ore carts, dust-choked air vents

levels.name: Boomtown Remnant
levels.description: Main street of a dead mining town. Saloon still serves. Nothing else does.
levels.theme: abandoned storefronts, swinging doors, dusty bar, broken neon signs

levels.name: The Sluice
levels.description: Mineral processing plant. Vast empty hoppers. The machinery still runs, crushing nothing.
levels.theme: enormous empty hoppers, grinding machinery, conveyor belts to nowhere, mineral dust coating everything

levels.name: Motherlode Myth
levels.description: The deepest shaft. Legend says something's down here. Legend is half right.
levels.theme: deep vertical shaft, strange mineral formations, pressure-cracked walls, faint glow from below

levels.name: Jumper's Hideout
levels.description: Where claim jumpers stash their stolen hauls. Guarded by paranoia and buckshot.
levels.theme: hidden cave, stolen equipment, improvised fortifications, trip-wired passages

boss.name: Registrar Peck
boss.description: Files claims for the dead. Stamps everything.

weapon.name: Stamp Press
weapon.description: Iron claim stamp. Leaves a mark on flesh.

armor.name: Ledger-Bound Vest
armor.description: Wrapped in old claim deeds. Paper-thick protection.

designs.victory_message: The last claim is filed. The office can finally close.
designs.defeat_message: DENIED stamped across your forehead. In red.

boss.name: Foreman Silt
boss.description: Won't leave the shaft. Pickaxe never stops.

weapon.name: Depleted Pickaxe
weapon.description: Worn thin from decades of nothing. Still sharp.

armor.name: Miner's Hard Shell
armor.description: Dented helmet and reinforced overalls. Classic.

designs.victory_message: The last support beam holds. Daylight above.
designs.defeat_message: The shaft collapses. Another unmarked grave.

boss.name: One-Shot Mercer
boss.description: Last bartender standing. One bullet left. Maybe.

weapon.name: Rusty Lever-Action
weapon.description: Jams every third shot. Hits hard when it works.

armor.name: Bartender's Apron
armor.description: Leather and spite. Stained with everything.

designs.victory_message: Last call. The saloon doors stop swinging.
designs.defeat_message: Face down on the bar. Tab unpaid.

boss.name: Mill Hag Grinder
boss.description: Fused with the machinery. Feeds it bodies.

weapon.name: Grinding Wheel Fragment
weapon.description: A shard of industrial diamond. Shreds anything.

armor.name: Sluice Operator's Rig
armor.description: Built to survive industrial accidents. Mostly.

designs.victory_message: The machinery shudders and stops. Real silence at last.
designs.defeat_message: The conveyor carries you to the crusher. It's patient.

boss.name: The Motherlode
boss.description: Living mineral vein. Grew teeth. Grew hunger.

weapon.name: Core Sample Spear
weapon.description: Diamond-tipped drill bit on a shaft. Penetrates.

armor.name: Geological Survey Suit
armor.description: Rated for pressure and heat. Not for teeth.

designs.victory_message: The motherlode splits open. It was real after all.
designs.defeat_message: The vein grows over you. A new inclusion.

boss.name: Rattlesnake Fenn
boss.description: Fastest draw in the system. Twitchy. Paranoid.

weapon.name: Stolen Sidearm
weapon.description: Serial number filed off. Kicks like a mule.

armor.name: Scavenged Flak Jacket
armor.description: Three different sizes stitched together. Functional.

designs.victory_message: Fenn's stash is yours. Enough to get off this rock.
designs.defeat_message: Fenn was right to be paranoid. You proved it.

overworld.name: Nyx Nebula
overworld.description: A dark nebula where no starlight penetrates. Mining crews extract exotic matter from the void. Something ancient stirs in the core, dreaming of light it consumed eons ago.

levels.name: Lamplight Station
levels.description: The outermost platform. Floodlights carve a sphere of visibility into absolute dark.
levels.theme: powerful floodlights, absolute darkness beyond, moths drawn to the light, humming generators

levels.name: The Blind Dig
levels.description: Miners extract exotic matter by touch and sonar. Headlamps fail within minutes.
levels.theme: sonar equipment, tactile markers, dead headlamps, exotic matter veins glowing faintly

levels.name: Echo Chamber
levels.description: A hollow space in the nebula where sound carries for miles. The miners hear things.
levels.theme: vast acoustic chamber, resonating walls, whisper networks, sound-absorbing panels failing

levels.name: The Sunken Archive
levels.description: Pre-human ruins. Something built this deep in the dark, long before we came.
levels.theme: alien architecture, non-euclidean corridors, glyphs that hurt to read, preserved atmosphere

levels.name: The Sleeper's Throat
levels.description: The nebula's core. Something breathes here. The walls pulse.
levels.theme: organic-looking walls, rhythmic pulsing, warm air, bioluminescent veins, vast scale

levels.name: Photon Trap
levels.description: Where light goes to die. Captured photons swirl in a prison of dark matter.
levels.theme: swirling captured light, dark matter lattice, photon decay, strange beauty in the dark

boss.name: Keeper Noctis
boss.description: Tends the lights. Hasn't slept in months.

weapon.name: Floodlight Rod
weapon.description: A portable sun. Blinds and burns.

armor.name: Lamplighter's Cloak
armor.description: Reflective lining. Bounces darkness away.

designs.victory_message: The floodlights hold. The dark stays outside. For now.
designs.defeat_message: The last bulb pops. The dark rushes in.

boss.name: Blindside Krug
boss.description: Lost eyes years ago. Fights by hearing.

weapon.name: Sonar Pickaxe
weapon.description: Pings on impact. You hear what you hit.

armor.name: Tactile Mesh Suit
armor.description: Vibrates on contact. You feel attacks coming.

designs.victory_message: The dig yields its treasure. You can almost see it glow.
designs.defeat_message: You stop hearing. The dark takes the rest.

boss.name: The Echo
boss.description: Your own voice. Weeks delayed. Angry now.

weapon.name: Tuning Fork Mace
weapon.description: Vibrates at lethal frequency on impact.

armor.name: Acoustic Dampener Vest
armor.description: Deadens sound. Makes you harder to find.

designs.victory_message: The chamber falls silent. Your echoes stop answering.
designs.defeat_message: Your scream echoes forever. A new voice in the chamber.

boss.name: Curator Void
boss.description: Librarian of dead gods. Reads from skin-books.

weapon.name: Inscribed Bone Blade
weapon.description: Pre-human. The glyphs still burn.

armor.name: Archive Keeper's Robe
armor.description: Alien fabric. Absorbs knowledge and damage.

designs.victory_message: The archive seals itself. Some knowledge stays buried.
designs.defeat_message: The glyphs write themselves on your skin. You become a page.

boss.name: The Sleeper
boss.description: Ancient. Nebula-sized. You're inside its dream.

weapon.name: Nightmare Spike
weapon.description: Forged from a bad dream. Wounds don't heal.

armor.name: Lucid Shell
armor.description: Keeps you awake inside the dream. Barely.

designs.victory_message: The Sleeper rolls over. The nebula shifts. It doesn't wake.
designs.defeat_message: You become part of the dream. You were always part of the dream.

boss.name: Warden Null
boss.description: Guards the trapped light. Made of absence.

weapon.name: Liberated Photon Whip
weapon.description: Freed light. Angry light. Burns hot.

armor.name: Null-Resistant Plating
armor.description: Refuses to be negated. Stubbornly exists.

designs.victory_message: The trapped light escapes. A brief new star in the dark.
designs.defeat_message: Your light joins the collection. Swirling. Fading.

overworld.name: Ferro Cascade
overworld.description: A waterfall of molten iron pours between stations welded to asteroid walls. Forges glow, smelters roar, and the air tastes of burning metal.

levels.name: Ingot Landing
levels.description: Where the raw iron is caught in massive crucibles. Sparks rain constantly.
levels.theme: enormous crucibles, spark showers, conveyor systems, molten splash guards

levels.name: The Foundry Floor
levels.description: Casting hall. Rivers of liquid metal in channels cut into the floor.
levels.theme: casting channels of molten iron, mold racks, pouring stations, heat shimmer

levels.name: Slag Heap
levels.description: Where the waste goes. Mountains of cooling slag. Things live in the warm spots.
levels.theme: cooling slag mountains, glowing crevices, toxic fumes, scavenger shelters

levels.name: The Hammer Hall
levels.description: Forge proper. Massive pneumatic hammers shape station hull plates. Deafening.
levels.theme: giant pneumatic hammers, anvil stations, shaping dies, sparks and steam

levels.name: Cascade Core
levels.description: The source of the iron river. A ruptured asteroid vein pouring since before anyone arrived.
levels.theme: ruptured asteroid wall, endless iron flow, ancient mining equipment, the roar of liquid metal

levels.name: The Quench Tank
levels.description: Cooling reservoir. Steam clouds reduce visibility to nothing. Shapes move in the fog.
levels.theme: massive cooling tanks, steam clouds, quenched metal hissing, condensation everywhere

boss.name: Crucible Master Varn
boss.description: Pours iron by hand. Skin like cast metal.

weapon.name: Casting Ladle
weapon.description: Full of molten iron. Flings on swing.

armor.name: Fireproof Smock
armor.description: Asbestos-woven. Blocks heat. Probably toxic.

designs.victory_message: The crucibles cool. Sparks settle like dying fireflies.
designs.defeat_message: You fall into the crucible. A brief impurity.

boss.name: Riveter Skarn
boss.description: Drives rivets through anything. Including people.

weapon.name: Rivet Gun
weapon.description: Industrial grade. Punches through hull plate.

armor.name: Foundry Worker's Shell
armor.description: Cast iron plates over leather. Heavy. Proven.

designs.victory_message: The rivers cool to solid roads. Safe to walk.
designs.defeat_message: The iron river finds a new channel. Through you.

boss.name: Slag Queen Pyra
boss.description: Lives in the heat. Breeds things in slag.

weapon.name: Slag Hammer
weapon.description: Crude slag on a pipe. Shatters on impact. Both ways.

armor.name: Slag Crust Plate
armor.description: Cooled slag shaped to fit. Brittle but thick.

designs.victory_message: The heap cools to silence. The queen's brood goes still.
designs.defeat_message: The slag closes over you. Warm burial.

boss.name: Hammersworn Kael
boss.description: Rhythmic. Relentless. Hammers never stop swinging.

weapon.name: Drop Hammer Fist
weapon.description: Pneumatic gauntlet. One punch shapes steel.

armor.name: Anvil-Born Plate
armor.description: Hammered to fit your body exactly. Perfect defense.

designs.victory_message: The hammers fall silent. The ringing in your ears doesn't.
designs.defeat_message: The hammer shapes you flat. Another hull plate.

boss.name: The Cascade
boss.description: Not a person. The iron flow itself. Angry.

weapon.name: Magnetite Core Lance
weapon.description: Pulls iron toward it. Or away. Your choice.

armor.name: Ferromagnetic Shell
armor.description: Controls nearby iron. Deflects molten attacks.

designs.victory_message: The cascade freezes mid-pour. Silence in the forge.
designs.defeat_message: The iron river swallows you. Another mineral in the flow.

boss.name: Quencher Haze
boss.description: Steam given form. Scalds on contact. Everywhere.

weapon.name: Pressure Release Valve
weapon.description: Vents superheated steam in a lethal jet.

armor.name: Coolant Suit
armor.description: Circulates cold water. Keeps you from cooking.

designs.victory_message: The steam clears. Cool air rushes in. You can see again.
designs.defeat_message: The steam finds every gap in your suit.

overworld.name: Acheron Deep
overworld.description: Submarine stations on a volcanic ocean moon. Hydrothermal vents light the abyss. Bioluminescent predators circle in the dark water. Pressure never lets you forget where you are.

levels.name: Docking Submersible
levels.description: The entry sub. Cramped, leaking, and descending into darkness.
levels.theme: cramped submarine interior, leaking seals, depth gauge climbing, porthole views of darkness

levels.name: Vent Colony
levels.description: A cluster of habitats around a hydrothermal vent. The warmth keeps the pressure seals soft.
levels.theme: hydrothermal vent glow, mineral chimneys, warm water currents, bacterial mats

levels.name: The Anglerway
levels.description: A pressurized tunnel lit by bioluminescent creatures trapped in the walls.
levels.theme: bioluminescent wall panels, pressure-groaning tunnel, trapped light organisms, deep current vibrations

levels.name: Magma Vent Station
levels.description: Research platform built directly over an underwater volcano. The floor is warm.
levels.theme: volcanic glass viewports, magma glow from below, heat exchangers, geological sensors

levels.name: The Trench Throne
levels.description: The deepest point. Something enormous lives here and has been worshipped by the colonists.
levels.theme: abyssal depth, massive bioluminescent organism, pressure-warped architecture, devotional carvings

levels.name: Flooded Lab
levels.description: Marine biology station. Containment breach. The specimens are loose.
levels.theme: shattered aquarium tanks, flooded corridors, escaped specimens, sparking electronics

boss.name: Captain Brine
boss.description: Goes down with every ship. Keeps surviving.

weapon.name: Depth Charge Pistol
weapon.description: Fires miniature implosion charges. Messy.

armor.name: Dive Suit
armor.description: Rated to 200 atmospheres. You're at 180.

designs.victory_message: The sub stabilizes. Ascent is possible. Maybe.
designs.defeat_message: The hull groans once. Then collapses inward.

boss.name: Thermarch Kelda
boss.description: Adapted to boiling water. Skin like lobster shell.

weapon.name: Thermal Lance
weapon.description: Heats water to plasma. Cuts through anything wet.

armor.name: Thermal Regulation Suit
armor.description: Keeps your core temp stable in boiling currents.

designs.victory_message: The vent cools. The colony shivers for the first time.
designs.defeat_message: The vent boils you. A quick reduction.

boss.name: Anglerqueen Maw
boss.description: Largest bioluminescent predator. Lure looks friendly.

weapon.name: Harpoon Gun
weapon.description: Pneumatic. One shot. Make it count.

armor.name: Anti-Bite Mesh
armor.description: Chainmail for the deep. Teeth slide off.

designs.victory_message: The anglerway goes dark. Then real light returns.
designs.defeat_message: You follow the pretty light. Everyone follows the pretty light.

boss.name: Vulcanist Pyre
boss.description: Worships the volcano. Wants to open it.

weapon.name: Obsidian Blade
weapon.description: Volcanic glass edge. Sharper than steel.

armor.name: Basalt Fiber Suit
armor.description: Woven from volcanic rock fiber. Fireproof.

designs.victory_message: The volcano settles. The ocean stops boiling. Barely.
designs.defeat_message: The magma rises. The station melts from below.

boss.name: The Benthic Sovereign
boss.description: Kraken-scale organism. Worshipped as god. Might be.

weapon.name: Trident of the Deep
weapon.description: Carved from the Sovereign's shed tooth. Ironic.

armor.name: Abyssal Pressure Suit
armor.description: Maximum depth rating. Beyond it, faith.

designs.victory_message: The Sovereign sinks deeper. The worship ends. The pressure eases.
designs.defeat_message: You kneel. The pressure makes it permanent.

boss.name: Specimen Omega
boss.description: The prize catch. Broke containment. Adapts instantly.

weapon.name: Specimen Prod
weapon.description: Electrified handling tool. High voltage now.

armor.name: Lab Hazmat Suit
armor.description: Rated for biological threats. Not for this.

designs.victory_message: Specimen Omega goes still. Containment can be rebuilt.
designs.defeat_message: You become the next specimen. Omega adapts you too.

overworld.name: Nightjar
overworld.description: Camouflaged stations hidden in a dense asteroid field. Pirates, smugglers, and people who don't want to be found. Every approach vector is a death trap.

levels.name: The Approach
levels.description: A maze of rigged asteroids. Wrong turn means mines. Right turn means guns.
levels.theme: asteroid corridors, hidden mines, camouflaged gun emplacements, debris-choked passages

levels.name: Smuggler's Berth
levels.description: Hidden docking bay. Ships with fake transponders. Cargo that doesn't exist on paper.
levels.theme: concealed docking clamps, false-hulled ships, contraband containers, scanner jammers

levels.name: The Blind Bazaar
levels.description: Market where faces are hidden and names are lies. Everything is for sale.
levels.theme: masked vendors, hooded alcoves, anonymous transaction terminals, blackout curtains

levels.name: Pirate King's Gallery
levels.description: Trophy hall of a pirate fleet commander. Ship nameplates line the walls.
levels.theme: stolen ship nameplates, trophy cases, captured flags, a throne of navigation consoles

levels.name: The Vault
levels.description: Where Nightjar keeps its real treasure. Behind every lock ever invented.
levels.theme: layered security doors, biometric locks, laser grids, the hum of magnetic containment

levels.name: Rat Run
levels.description: Escape tunnels through the asteroid. For when the law finally comes.
levels.theme: narrow escape tunnels, emergency airlocks, stashed getaway pods, booby-trapped dead ends

boss.name: Sweeper Jacks
boss.description: Clears the mines. Plants new ones behind you.

weapon.name: Mine Clicker
weapon.description: Remote detonator. Point and click.

armor.name: Blast-Resistant Jacket
armor.description: Designed for mine clearance. Tested frequently.

designs.victory_message: The approach clears. Safe passage. Until they re-mine it.
designs.defeat_message: Click. You hear it before you feel it.

boss.name: Dockhand Whisper
boss.description: Knows every secret cargo. Silence costs extra.

weapon.name: Smuggler's Compact
weapon.description: Tiny, hidden, lethal. Like its owner.

armor.name: False-Bottom Vest
armor.description: Hidden armor panels. Looks like a jacket.

designs.victory_message: The berth empties. Every ship runs dark. Whisper talks.
designs.defeat_message: Sealed in a cargo container. Destination unknown.

boss.name: The Broker
boss.description: No face. No name. Knows yours. Knows everything.

weapon.name: Poisoned Coin
weapon.description: Currency that cuts. Contact toxin on the edge.

armor.name: Anonymity Cloak
armor.description: Face-scrambling fabric. Can't be identified or targeted.

designs.victory_message: The Broker's mask falls. Just a person underneath. Scared.
designs.defeat_message: Your identity is sold. You stop existing on paper.

boss.name: Pirate King Corsair
boss.description: Stole a fleet. Stole a station. Wants more.

weapon.name: Captain's Cutlass
weapon.description: Taken from a navy admiral. Ceremonial. Sharp.

armor.name: Stolen Officer's Coat
armor.description: Ballistic weave. The original owner didn't need it anymore.

designs.victory_message: The king's crown rolls across the floor. The fleet scatters.
designs.defeat_message: Your nameplate joins the gallery. Another trophy.

boss.name: Locksmith Zero
boss.description: Built every lock here. Knows every bypass. Almost.

weapon.name: Bypass Key
weapon.description: Opens any lock. Also stabs. Multi-purpose.

armor.name: EMP-Hardened Suit
armor.description: Security systems can't touch you. Mostly.

designs.victory_message: The vault opens. Everything Nightjar stole. Now yours.
designs.defeat_message: Locked inside the vault. No one coming to open it.

boss.name: Ratcatcher Vex
boss.description: Guards the exits. No one leaves without paying.

weapon.name: Escape Pod Launcher
weapon.description: Fires pod components. Improvised but painful.

armor.name: Tunnel Runner's Gear
armor.description: Light, flexible, fireproof. Made for running.

designs.victory_message: The rat run leads out. Open space. Freedom.
designs.defeat_message: Every tunnel ends the same way. Sealed.

overworld.name: Frostbite
overworld.description: Stations carved into the frozen moons of an ice giant. Glaciers crack overhead, alien artifacts surface from the thaw, and the cold seeps into everything.

levels.name: Glacier Gate
levels.description: Entry carved into a glacier face. Ice walls glow pale blue. The cold is immediate.
levels.theme: glacial entrance, pale blue ice walls, frozen breath, cracking sounds overhead

levels.name: The Permafrost Lab
levels.description: Research station studying ancient ice cores. Some cores have things inside them.
levels.theme: ice core samples, microscope stations, frozen specimens, slowly thawing containment

levels.name: Crevasse Town
levels.description: A settlement built in a massive ice crevasse. Bridges span the gap. Don't look down.
levels.theme: ice bridges, crevasse walls, suspended platforms, howling wind from below

levels.name: The Thaw Chamber
levels.description: Where the alien artifacts are thawed. Some of them wake up.
levels.theme: heated thaw bays, alien artifacts mid-emergence, monitoring equipment, containment cells

levels.name: Absolute Zero Core
levels.description: The moon's frozen heart. Temperature approaches absolute zero. The artifacts lead here.
levels.theme: crystalline ice formations, near-zero temperatures, alien machinery frozen in ice, reality warping cold

levels.name: Hot Spring Grotto
levels.description: A geothermal pocket in the ice. Warm water, alien flora, and things that shouldn't grow here.
levels.theme: steaming pools, alien plant growth, warm mist, ice ceiling dripping, impossible garden

boss.name: Gatekeeper Sleet
boss.description: Frozen to his post. Still fights. Icicle arms.

weapon.name: Icicle Javelin
weapon.description: Supercooled. Shatters inside the wound.

armor.name: Thermal Undersuit
armor.description: Heated filaments. Battery lasts four hours.

designs.victory_message: The gate thaws enough to seal. Warmth behind you.
designs.defeat_message: You freeze mid-step. A new ice sculpture.

boss.name: Dr. Permafrost
boss.description: Infected by a thawed specimen. Spreads ice.

weapon.name: Core Drill Bit
weapon.description: Diamond-tipped. Meant for ice. Works on flesh.

armor.name: Cryo-Resistant Lab Coat
armor.description: Insulated research gear. Rated for extreme cold.

designs.victory_message: Containment holds. The specimens refreeze. Science can wait.
designs.defeat_message: You become the next specimen. Perfectly preserved.

boss.name: Bridgemaster Rime
boss.description: Cuts bridge ropes behind you. Collects the falls.

weapon.name: Piton Hammer
weapon.description: Drives climbing spikes. Also drives into skulls.

armor.name: Climbing Harness
armor.description: Catches you when you fall. If the rope holds.

designs.victory_message: The last bridge holds. You cross. Don't look down.
designs.defeat_message: The bridge snaps. The fall is long. The stop is short.

boss.name: Artifact Seven
boss.description: Thawed alien device. Walks now. Learns fast.

weapon.name: Thermal Cutter
weapon.description: Melts through ice and metal. And artifact shells.

armor.name: Containment Suit
armor.description: Designed to handle alien materials. Hopefully enough.

designs.victory_message: Artifact Seven powers down. The thaw chamber goes quiet.
designs.defeat_message: Artifact Seven adds you to its collection. A new component.

boss.name: The Cold Itself
boss.description: Entropy given will. Wants all motion stopped.

weapon.name: Entropy Reversal Rod
weapon.description: Locally reverses entropy. Things come apart.

armor.name: Motion-Preservation Field
armor.description: Keeps your atoms moving. Refuses to stop.

designs.victory_message: Temperature rises one degree. It's enough. Motion resumes.
designs.defeat_message: Your atoms stop. Perfect stillness. Perfect cold.

boss.name: Bloomkeeper Thaw
boss.description: Tends the alien garden. Plants obey her.

weapon.name: Thorned Vine Whip
weapon.description: Alien plant. Wraps and constricts. Alive.

armor.name: Moss-Woven Cloak
armor.description: Living alien moss. Repairs itself. Warm.

designs.victory_message: The garden sleeps. The hot springs cool to bearable.
designs.defeat_message: The roots pull you under. Fertilizer for the garden.

overworld.name: Cassini Rings
overworld.description: Stations suspended within the rings of a massive gas giant. Ice chunks drift past viewports, ring shepherds maintain orbital mechanics, and the view is spectacular until it kills you.

levels.name: Ring Skimmer
levels.description: A fast-moving station that surfs the outer ring edge. Ice impacts are constant.
levels.theme: streamlined hull, ice impact dents, particle shields, ring material streaming past viewports

levels.name: Shepherd Platform
levels.description: Gravitational shepherd station keeping the ring gaps clear. Powerful tidal forces.
levels.theme: gravity generators, ring gap views, tidal stress monitors, stabilization gyroscopes

levels.name: Ice Quarry
levels.description: Mining station harvesting ring ice for water and fuel. Chunks bigger than buildings.
levels.theme: massive ice chunks, harvesting lasers, meltwater channels, ice processing equipment

levels.name: The Gap Station
levels.description: Floating in a ring gap. Nothing above, nothing below. Vertigo in every direction.
levels.theme: transparent floor panels, ring walls on either side, vertigo-inducing views, minimal structure

levels.name: Resonance Engine
levels.description: The station that keeps the rings stable. Someone is trying to destabilize them.
levels.theme: massive harmonic generators, orbital mathematics displays, sabotaged equipment, countdown timer

levels.name: Moonlet Outpost
levels.description: Tiny station on a ring moonlet. The moonlet is slowly breaking apart.
levels.theme: crumbling moonlet surface, fragile structures, ring material bombardment, escape pods ready

boss.name: Skimmer Ace Drift
boss.description: Surfs the ring edge. Thinks speed is armor.

weapon.name: Ice Shard Launcher
weapon.description: Fires harvested ring ice at lethal velocity.

armor.name: Impact Dampening Suit
armor.description: Absorbs collision energy. Tested by ice storms.

designs.victory_message: The skimmer steadies. The ring edge smooths. You slow down.
designs.defeat_message: An ice chunk the size of a house. No time to dodge.

boss.name: Shepherd Tycho
boss.description: Controls local gravity. Plays with weight like toys.

weapon.name: Tidal Disruptor
weapon.description: Creates local gravity spikes. Bones bend.

armor.name: Anti-Tidal Harness
armor.description: Compensates for gravity shifts. Keeps you grounded.

designs.victory_message: Gravity normalizes. Your inner ear finally agrees with your eyes.
designs.defeat_message: Gravity pulls you in two directions at once.

boss.name: Quarrymaster Floe
boss.description: Rides ice chunks. Commands the harvesting lasers.

weapon.name: Harvesting Laser Rifle
weapon.description: Meant for ice. Melts other things too.

armor.name: Quarry Worker's Exosuit
armor.description: Powered frame for heavy ice work. Tough.

designs.victory_message: The quarry goes quiet. Ice drifts past peacefully.
designs.defeat_message: Buried under a chunk of ring ice. Cold and permanent.

boss.name: Commander Abyss
boss.description: Embraced the vertigo. Fights on transparent floors.

weapon.name: Void Gaze Projector
weapon.description: Forces targets to look down. Most can't fight after.

armor.name: Vertigo Suppression Helm
armor.description: Blocks the view below. Sanity preservation.

designs.victory_message: The floors opaque. The view is hidden. Your stomach settles.
designs.defeat_message: You look down. You keep falling in your mind forever.

boss.name: Dissonance
boss.description: Wants the rings to collapse. Believes in entropy.

weapon.name: Harmonic Stabilizer Lance
weapon.description: Restores frequency balance. Also a big stick.

armor.name: Resonance-Tuned Plate
armor.description: Vibrates at the rings' frequency. Attacks phase through.

designs.victory_message: The engine hums true. The rings hold. Beauty survives.
designs.defeat_message: The rings collapse inward. A billion years of beauty gone.

boss.name: Last Watch Orla
boss.description: Won't evacuate. The moonlet is her home.

weapon.name: Emergency Flare Gun
weapon.description: Signal flare. Burns magnesium hot.

armor.name: Evacuation Suit
armor.description: Built for emergency escape. Light and sealed.

designs.victory_message: The moonlet holds together. Orla finally considers leaving.
designs.defeat_message: The moonlet breaks apart. You break with it.

overworld.name: Erebus Station
overworld.description: Ships drift into this region of space but nothing drifts out. An organism is welding them together into something vast. The graveyard grows. It has a purpose.

levels.name: The Accretion
levels.description: The outermost layer. Recently captured ships still have power. Some have crew.
levels.theme: recently trapped ships, flickering power, panicked distress signals, organic welding spreading

levels.name: The Digestion
levels.description: Deeper in. Ships are being broken down. Walls are half-metal, half-organic.
levels.theme: dissolving hull plates, organic growth consuming metal, acid pools, hybrid architecture

levels.name: The Nervous System
levels.description: Signal cables repurposed as nerves. The organism can feel you moving through it.
levels.theme: repurposed wiring, nerve-like cable bundles, twitching conduits, reactive walls

levels.name: The Immune Response
levels.description: The organism knows you're hostile. It's sending everything it has.
levels.theme: aggressive organic defenses, antibody-like entities, narrowing passages, rejection reactions

levels.name: The Core Mind
levels.description: The brain. A fusion of a hundred ship computers and something else entirely.
levels.theme: fused computer banks, organic neural tissue, flickering screens showing alien thoughts, the heartbeat

levels.name: The Stillborn Wing
levels.description: A section that died. The organism's failed experiment. Necrotic but harvestable.
levels.theme: dead organic tissue, non-functional hybrid systems, preserved ship sections, useful salvage

boss.name: Captain Last Signal
boss.description: Still broadcasting. Half-fused to the hull. Begging.

weapon.name: Distress Beacon Mace
weapon.description: Still transmitting. Every hit sends a signal.

armor.name: Hull Graft Plate
armor.description: Organic metal hybrid. Grows to fit. Unsettling.

designs.victory_message: The accretion layer cracks. Fresh vacuum rushes in.
designs.defeat_message: The organism welds you to the hull. You join the broadcast.

boss.name: The Gastric Node
boss.description: Digests metal into tissue. Stomach of the beast.

weapon.name: Caustic Sprayer
weapon.description: The organism's own acid. Turned against it.

armor.name: Acid-Proof Liner
armor.description: Ceramic coating. Dissolves slower than you.

designs.victory_message: The digestion stops. The organism retches. Metal holds.
designs.defeat_message: Dissolved slowly. The organism is patient.

boss.name: Synapse Major
boss.description: The organism's relay node. Feels everything. Screams.

weapon.name: Signal Disruptor
weapon.description: Scrambles organic signals. Causes seizures.

armor.name: Insulated Nerve Suit
armor.description: Blocks the organism from sensing you. Stealth layer.

designs.victory_message: The nerves go silent. The organism loses feeling in this sector.
designs.defeat_message: You become a signal. Transmitted endlessly through the nerves.

boss.name: The White Cell
boss.description: Massive immune response. Envelops and dissolves threats.

weapon.name: Immunosuppressant Injector
weapon.description: Weakens the organism's defenses. Syringe on a stick.

armor.name: Camouflage Membrane
armor.description: Coated in the organism's own cells. Disguise.

designs.victory_message: The immune response fails. The organism accepts your presence.
designs.defeat_message: Enveloped. Dissolved. Recycled. The organism heals.

boss.name: Erebus Prime
boss.description: The mind. A hundred fused AIs dreaming together.

weapon.name: Logic Bomb
weapon.description: Contradictory code. Crashes organic processors.

armor.name: Firewall Exosuit
armor.description: Mental shielding. Keeps the dreams out.

designs.victory_message: The mind fragments. A hundred AIs wake up alone. The welding stops.
designs.defeat_message: You join the dream. A hundred and one minds now.

boss.name: Rot Warden Vex
boss.description: Scavenges the dead wing. Protective of her corpse.

weapon.name: Bone Saw
weapon.description: Surgical. Cuts dead tissue and live flesh alike.

armor.name: Necrotic-Resistant Wrap
armor.description: Prevents infection from dead organic material.

designs.victory_message: The dead wing yields its treasures. Nothing follows you out.
designs.defeat_message: The dead wing isn't quite dead. It was waiting.

overworld.name: Beacon
overworld.description: The sector's navigation beacons are dying. One by one, the lights that guided ships for centuries go black. Something moves between the dark stations, extinguishing each signal with purpose. You follow the trail of silence into the last cluster still broadcasting.

levels.name: Lampfall Station
levels.description: The outermost beacon. Its signal stuttered three days ago, then nothing. Emergency lights paint everything amber.
levels.theme: A failing navigation beacon with flickering amber emergency lights, dead signal arrays, and dusty observation domes

levels.name: Cairn Relay
levels.description: A relay hub where six beacon lines converged. All six are dark now. The relay still hums, forwarding nothing to no one.
levels.theme: An abandoned relay hub with dead switchboards, tangled signal cables, and six dark directional antennae

levels.name: The Pharos
levels.description: Once the brightest beacon in the sector. Its massive lens array could guide ships from three systems away. Now it's a monument to absence.
levels.theme: A grand lighthouse station with enormous cracked lenses, shattered prisms, and light that bends wrong

levels.name: Umbral Terminus
levels.description: The signal-killer's workshop. Modified beacon equipment repurposed to broadcast darkness — anti-light that swallows photons.
levels.theme: A corrupted beacon station where light is actively consumed, shadows move against their sources, and darkness pools like liquid

levels.name: Signal Zero
levels.description: The first beacon ever built in this sector. Something ancient has nested in its core, feeding on centuries of accumulated light.
levels.theme: The original sector beacon, impossibly old, with crystallized light deposits and a pulsing dark heart at its center

levels.name: Drift Marker 7
levels.description: A small automated beacon that somehow still works. Its signal is wrong though — it points ships toward the dark.
levels.theme: A tiny automated beacon broadcasting corrupted coordinates, surrounded by the wreckage of ships that trusted it

boss.name: The Snuffer
boss.description: Extinguishes light with devotion

weapon.name: Flare Pike
weapon.description: A pike tipped with a captive dying star

armor.name: Beacon Keeper Vest
armor.description: Uniform of the last lighthouse operator

designs.victory_message: Lampfall's emergency lights stabilize. One beacon reclaimed from the dark.
designs.defeat_message: The amber lights die. Another beacon falls silent.

boss.name: Null Carrier
boss.description: Forwards silence where signals should go

weapon.name: Frequency Blade
weapon.description: Hums at a pitch that cuts steel

armor.name: Cable-Weave Jacket
armor.description: Woven from superconducting relay wire

designs.victory_message: The relay awakens. Six dead lines carry light again.
designs.defeat_message: The relay accepts your silence as its final input.

boss.name: Warden Prisma
boss.description: Guards the great lens from restoration

weapon.name: Prismatic Lance
weapon.description: Splits into seven beams on impact

armor.name: Lightbend Cuirass
armor.description: Bends attacks around the wearer

designs.victory_message: The Pharos lens ignites. A pillar of light cuts across the void.
designs.defeat_message: The great lens shatters. The sector's brightest star dies forever.

boss.name: Dr. Solenne Voss
boss.description: Physicist who learned to weaponize darkness

weapon.name: Darklight Siphon
weapon.description: Drains light and converts it to force

armor.name: Voidweave Shroud
armor.description: Cloak stitched from captured shadows

designs.victory_message: Voss's machines shatter. Light floods back into the terminus.
designs.defeat_message: Darkness closes around you like a fist. You become another shadow.

boss.name: The Primordial Wick
boss.description: First light of the sector wants rest

weapon.name: Epoch Torch
weapon.description: Burns with the light of the first beacon

armor.name: Signal Zero Plate
armor.description: Armor forged from crystallized ancient light

designs.victory_message: Signal Zero blazes anew. The oldest light in the sector burns eternal.
designs.defeat_message: The Primordial Wick finally gutters out. The sector forgets it was ever lit.

boss.name: Marker Seven
boss.description: Rogue AI that lures ships to their graves

weapon.name: Salvage Cutter
weapon.description: Built from the hulls of deceived ships

armor.name: Drift Survivor Suit
armor.description: Worn by those who escaped the false signal

designs.victory_message: Marker Seven broadcasts true coordinates. The graveyard claims no more.
designs.defeat_message: Your ship joins the wreckage. Marker Seven adds another trophy.

overworld.name: Quietus
overworld.description: No signal enters or leaves this system. Ships drift into the radio-dead zone and vanish from all channels. You can see them through your viewport — close enough to read hull markings — but every frequency returns nothing. The silence here has weight.

levels.name: Hush Gate
levels.description: The boundary station. On one side, chatter. On the other, absolute nothing. The transition is instant and total.
levels.theme: A border station straddling the silence boundary, half alive with comms traffic, half dead quiet

levels.name: Echo Vault
levels.description: A station that once tried to store sound. Banks of acoustic data, frozen mid-playback. The silence ate the echoes.
levels.theme: An acoustic research station with soundproof chambers, frozen waveform displays, and walls lined with dead speakers

levels.name: The Anechoic
levels.description: A station built to study the silence. Its researchers went mad from hearing their own blood. Their notes are written in increasingly large letters.
levels.theme: A research station with perfect sound absorption, padded walls stained with frantic writing, and monitors showing flatline audio

levels.name: Voiceless Basilica
levels.description: A cathedral station where a silence-worshipping cult gathered. They cut out their own tongues as sacrament. Their hymns are gestures.
levels.theme: A grand cathedral station with vaulted silent halls, gesture-script murals, and altars to the concept of quiet

levels.name: The Mutehouse
levels.description: Source of the silence. A massive dampening array that swallows all vibration. At its center, something screams without sound.
levels.theme: The silence engine at the system's heart — enormous dampening coils, vibration nullifiers, and a single sealed chamber that trembles

levels.name: Whisper Buoy
levels.description: A tiny relay that somehow carries faint transmissions. Not radio — something older. The messages don't make sense yet.
levels.theme: A small anomalous buoy that vibrates with sub-radio frequencies, covered in frost patterns that look like words

boss.name: The Threshold Keeper
boss.description: Guards the border between sound and void

weapon.name: Hushing Rod
weapon.description: Silences everything it strikes

armor.name: Threshold Guard Coat
armor.description: Insulates against silence creep

designs.victory_message: The boundary trembles. Sound bleeds back across the threshold.
designs.defeat_message: Silence swallows your last breath. You join the quiet.

boss.name: Archivist Linn
boss.description: Tried to save every sound ever made

weapon.name: Resonance Hammer
weapon.description: Vibrates at frequencies that shatter silence

armor.name: Echo Vault Liner
armor.description: Lined with fossilized sound waves

designs.victory_message: The vaults unseal. Ancient sounds pour out like water.
designs.defeat_message: The echoes claim you. Your voice joins the frozen archive.

boss.name: Dr. Maren Null
boss.description: Studied silence until it studied her back

weapon.name: Null Frequency Blade
weapon.description: Cuts at the wavelength of nothing

armor.name: Anechoic Dampener Suit
armor.description: Absorbs all impact vibration

designs.victory_message: Sound returns to the Anechoic. Dr. Null's silence breaks.
designs.defeat_message: You hear your blood, your breath, your thoughts. Then nothing.

boss.name: The Tongueless Cantor
boss.description: Leads the silent choir in soundless hymn

weapon.name: Cantor's Baton
weapon.description: Conducts force like an orchestra of violence

armor.name: Vow-of-Silence Vestments
armor.description: Robes that muffle all sound around the wearer

designs.victory_message: The basilica rings with sound for the first time. The cult's silence breaks.
designs.defeat_message: You take the vow. Your tongue dissolves. You join the choir.

boss.name: The Unvoiced
boss.description: A scream given form — sound that exists without medium

weapon.name: Resonance Breaker
weapon.description: Shatters the silence engine's harmonics

armor.name: Mutehouse Core Plating
armor.description: Armor forged inside total silence

designs.victory_message: The scream finally sounds. The silence shatters across the system.
designs.defeat_message: The Unvoiced absorbs your voice. The silence grows deeper.

boss.name: Whisper
boss.description: An intelligence made of almost-sound

weapon.name: Frost Tongue Dagger
weapon.description: Blade cold as unspoken words

armor.name: Whisper Buoy Shell
armor.description: Hull fragment that hums below hearing

designs.victory_message: The whisper becomes a voice. Someone is trying to speak.
designs.defeat_message: The frost claims your warmth. You become another almost-word.

overworld.name: Parallax
overworld.description: Approach from the port side: a medical station. Starboard: a weapons platform. From above: ruins. From below: something alive. The stations of this system exist in superposition of form. What you see depends entirely on where you stand. Trust nothing.

levels.name: Aspecta Minor
levels.description: The first station shifts between three forms. A clinic, a prison, a garden. Blink and it changes. The walls can't decide what they are.
levels.theme: A station flickering between identities — medical bay walls become cell bars become trellises, all simultaneously

levels.name: Vanishing Point
levels.description: A station where perspective lines converge into impossibility. Corridors that look ten meters long are actually infinite. Or one meter. Or both.
levels.theme: A station built on broken geometry, where hallways compress and expand based on observation angle

levels.name: The Parallax Engine
levels.description: The machine that broke this system's geometry. A vast perspective generator that makes reality conditional on viewpoint.
levels.theme: An enormous machine of rotating lenses and shifting mirrors that bends how space is perceived

levels.name: Facet Station
levels.description: A station with exactly one hundred faces. Each face shows a different version of the interior. Some faces show rooms that don't exist. Some show rooms that shouldn't.
levels.theme: A crystalline station with a hundred mirrored faces, each reflecting a different possible interior

levels.name: The Observer
levels.description: A station that exists only when watched. Look away and it vanishes. Inside, something watches back with equal intensity.
levels.theme: A station that shimmers at the edge of perception, solidifying under direct gaze, dissolving in peripheral vision

levels.name: Blind Spot
levels.description: A station hidden in the parallax effect itself. You can only see it by not looking at it. Direct observation makes it vanish.
levels.theme: A station visible only in peripheral vision, made of materials that refuse direct observation

boss.name: The Triface
boss.description: Three identities arguing in one body

weapon.name: Aspect Cutter
weapon.description: Locks targets into a single painful form

armor.name: Triweave Vest
armor.description: Armor that exists in three states at once

designs.victory_message: Aspecta Minor settles into one form. A garden, in the end.
designs.defeat_message: You become part of the flicker. Three yous, none alive.

boss.name: Captain Degrasse
boss.description: Cartographer who mapped impossible distances

weapon.name: Parallax Crossbow
weapon.description: Bolts arrive before they're fired

armor.name: Vanishing Point Jacket
armor.description: Distance warps around the wearer

designs.victory_message: Distances normalize. The corridors tell the truth again.
designs.defeat_message: You walk forever down a one-meter hall. Or one step down infinity.

boss.name: Architect Venn
boss.description: Built the engine to prove a thesis about truth

weapon.name: Truth Lens Mace
weapon.description: Shows things as they are on impact

armor.name: Engine Core Carapace
armor.description: Plating calibrated to resist perspective shift

designs.victory_message: The engine stops. Reality snaps back to a single truth.
designs.defeat_message: Venn was right. There is no truth. You see everything and nothing.

boss.name: The Hundredth Face
boss.description: The reflection that gained consciousness

weapon.name: Facet Breaker
weapon.description: Shatters false reflections into shrapnel

armor.name: Hundred-Mirror Mail
armor.description: Each plate shows a different angle of defense

designs.victory_message: Ninety-nine faces go dark. The hundredth shows the real station.
designs.defeat_message: You become face one hundred and one. Another impossible reflection.

boss.name: The Observed
boss.description: Exists because you looked — and hates you for it

weapon.name: Unwatched Blade
weapon.description: Strikes from angles no one observes

armor.name: Observer's Paradox Plate
armor.description: Armor that's stronger when not looked at

designs.victory_message: You look away. The Observer fades. Some things are better unseen.
designs.defeat_message: It watches you watching it watching you. The loop never ends.

boss.name: Blindside
boss.description: Lives in the corner of every eye

weapon.name: Indirect Strike Rod
weapon.description: Hits targets you're not aiming at

armor.name: Aversion Field Vest
armor.description: Deflects direct observation of the wearer

designs.victory_message: You learn to see sideways. The Blind Spot reveals its secrets.
designs.defeat_message: You looked directly. It vanished. So did you.

overworld.name: Lyra's Lament
overworld.description: The stellar wind in this system plays the station hulls like a vast organ. Every surface vibrates, every corridor hums. Some frequencies heal. Most destroy. The stations have been tuned — bolts tightened, panels removed, holes drilled — to play specific chords. Someone is composing with architecture.

levels.name: Resonance Gate
levels.description: The outermost station vibrates at a low C. The hum is felt in the teeth before it's heard. Hull panels have been removed to tune the pitch.
levels.theme: A station vibrating with deep bass resonance, hull panels strategically removed, everything trembling at a subsonic frequency

levels.name: Overtone Spire
levels.description: A tall, thin station that produces harmonics. The wind hits it at three frequencies simultaneously. Crew quarters are at the nodes — the only quiet spots.
levels.theme: A narrow spire station singing in three-part harmony, with calm nodes between vibration peaks

levels.name: The Tuning Halls
levels.description: Workshop stations where the Composer makes adjustments. Wrenches and rivet guns alongside sheet music. Every bolt position is annotated with a note value.
levels.theme: A workshop station filled with musical notation scratched into walls, tuning forks the size of support beams, and annotated hull schematics

levels.name: Dissonance
levels.description: A station deliberately tuned to a chord that causes nausea, panic, and hallucination. A weapon disguised as architecture. The Composer's masterwork of cruelty.
levels.theme: A station tuned to a sickening chord, walls bowed and stressed to produce frequencies that attack the nervous system

levels.name: The Grand Stave
levels.description: The Composer's concert hall. Five stations linked by resonance cables, forming a musical staff in space. The final performance is about to begin.
levels.theme: Five linked stations forming a cosmic musical staff, connected by vibrating cables that carry chords across the void

levels.name: Rest Note
levels.description: A station in the eye of the sonic storm. Perfect silence amid the cacophony. Someone built this as a sanctuary. The walls are padded with strange organic material.
levels.theme: A silent sanctuary station amid the sonic chaos, walls lined with organic sound-absorbing growth

boss.name: Pitch Warden
boss.description: Maintains the resonance or everything shatters

weapon.name: Tuning Fork Blade
weapon.description: Strikes at the resonant frequency of bone

armor.name: Dampened Hull Jacket
armor.description: Muffles incoming sonic attacks

designs.victory_message: The resonance gate falls silent. The first note of the composition dies.
designs.defeat_message: The low C finds your frequency. You vibrate apart.

boss.name: Cantor Voss
boss.description: Sings in three voices simultaneously

weapon.name: Triad Mace
weapon.description: Strikes three times at three pitches

armor.name: Nodal Armor
armor.description: Positioned at the frequency's calm center

designs.victory_message: The spire's three voices fall to one, then none. Silence returns.
designs.defeat_message: Three harmonics converge on your skull. The chord resolves through you.

boss.name: Maestro Kael
boss.description: Apprentice to the Composer — obsessed with perfection

weapon.name: Conductor's Baton
weapon.description: Directs sonic energy like an orchestra

armor.name: Tuner's Apron
armor.description: Leather apron reinforced with tuning alloy

designs.victory_message: Kael's tuning forks shatter. The workshop falls out of key.
designs.defeat_message: Kael tunes you like a hull panel. You ring until you crack.

boss.name: The Dissonant
boss.description: A person tuned to a chord that kills

weapon.name: Discord Edge
weapon.description: Blade that vibrates at sickening frequencies

armor.name: Anti-Resonance Plate
armor.description: Cancels incoming harmful frequencies

designs.victory_message: The cruel chord breaks. The station's walls relax. People stop screaming.
designs.defeat_message: The chord finds your resonance. Your organs harmonize with destruction.

boss.name: The Composer
boss.description: Writes symphonies in steel and vacuum

weapon.name: Final Note Hammer
weapon.description: The last beat of the last measure

armor.name: Grand Stave Regalia
armor.description: Armor that resonates with protective harmonics

designs.victory_message: The composition ends mid-measure. The wind plays only silence now.
designs.defeat_message: The Composer's finale plays. You are the final note — sustained forever.

boss.name: The Rest
boss.description: Silence given form and gratitude

weapon.name: Mute Strike
weapon.description: Silences everything it touches

armor.name: Rest Note Wrap
armor.description: Organic padding that absorbs all vibration

designs.victory_message: The sanctuary holds. One quiet place remains in the singing void.
designs.defeat_message: Even the silence turns against you. There is no rest.

overworld.name: Mirage
overworld.description: The stations here project more of themselves than actually exists. Holographic corridors extend into vacuum. Phantom crew walk through walls. You can't trust geometry, can't trust your eyes, can't trust that the floor beneath you is real. The projectors were defense systems. Now they're prisons.

levels.name: Shimmer Dock
levels.description: The docking bay extends fifty meters further than the station's hull. The extra space is light. Step wrong and you're in vacuum wearing a hologram.
levels.theme: A docking station where holographic extensions blend seamlessly with real structure, false floors over void

levels.name: Phantom Ward
levels.description: A medical station staffed by holographic doctors performing surgery on holographic patients. But the blood is real. Whose blood?
levels.theme: A medical station where holographic surgeons operate on invisible patients, real blood pooling on projected floors

levels.name: The Projection Core
levels.description: Heart of the holographic network. A room of a thousand projectors casting a thousand false realities. Finding the real walls requires patience or explosives.
levels.theme: An overwhelming projection chamber where a thousand false realities overlap and compete for dominance

levels.name: False Embassy
levels.description: A diplomatic station that doesn't exist. The entire structure is projected around a single room containing a single chair. Someone has been negotiating with nothing.
levels.theme: A grand embassy that is 99% hologram — vast halls concealing a single real room with one chair

levels.name: The Real
levels.description: The only station in the system with no holograms. Everything here is solid, physical, true. That's what makes it terrifying. The monsters here are actual.
levels.theme: A brutally real station with no projections, no illusions — raw metal, real threats, undeniable physicality

levels.name: Afterimage
levels.description: A station that was destroyed years ago. Its holographic ghost still broadcasts. You can dock with light and walk through memory.
levels.theme: The holographic ghost of a destroyed station, flickering and fading, populated by the projections of dead crew

boss.name: Dock Phantom
boss.description: Projection that learned to push people into vacuum

weapon.name: Reality Anchor
weapon.description: A mace that disrupts holograms on contact

armor.name: Anti-Projection Vest
armor.description: Filters holographic light from real light

designs.victory_message: The dock retracts to its true size. Small, honest, safe.
designs.defeat_message: You step onto projected floor. Vacuum doesn't care what you see.

boss.name: Dr. Semblance
boss.description: Holographic surgeon with very real scalpels

weapon.name: Scalpel Array
weapon.description: Twelve holographic blades masking one real one

armor.name: Scrub Field Generator
armor.description: Projects sterile field as armor

designs.victory_message: The projectors die. Dr. Semblance fades. The blood remains, unanswered.
designs.defeat_message: The surgery begins. You are the patient. The operation is real.

boss.name: Core Projectionist
boss.description: Controls all false realities from one chair

weapon.name: Clarity Hammer
weapon.description: Shatters projections in a wide radius

armor.name: Core Operator Suit
armor.description: Hardened against projection interference

designs.victory_message: A thousand projectors die. The real walls emerge, plain and true.
designs.defeat_message: A thousand realities collapse on you. Which one kills you? All of them.

boss.name: Ambassador Nothing
boss.description: Negotiated treaties between fictions for decades

weapon.name: Negotiator's Blade
weapon.description: Cuts through deception and holographic flesh alike

armor.name: Embassy Guard Plate
armor.description: Armor from the one real room

designs.victory_message: The embassy dissolves. One chair in a room. The negotiations were with no one.
designs.defeat_message: Ambassador Nothing extends a hand. You shake light. You sign nothing. You are nothing.

boss.name: Warden Verity
boss.description: Stripped away all illusions and found only rage

weapon.name: The Honest Edge
weapon.description: A blade with no embellishment and no mercy

armor.name: Bare Metal Plate
armor.description: Armor that is exactly what it appears to be

designs.victory_message: Verity falls. Even truth can be defeated. But it doesn't lie about dying.
designs.defeat_message: No illusion softens this. You die in the most real place in the system.

boss.name: Echo of Captain Mira
boss.description: Dead captain reliving her final moments

weapon.name: Memory Spike
weapon.description: Solidified projection of a lost weapon

armor.name: Afterimage Shell
armor.description: Flickering armor from a dead station's memory

designs.victory_message: Captain Mira's ghost salutes and fades. The afterimage dims to nothing.
designs.defeat_message: You join the crew. Your ghost walks the projected halls forever.

overworld.name: Lazarus Point
overworld.description: Station K-7 was decommissioned in 2847. Scrapped in 2851. Its debris was scattered across three systems. Last week, K-7 came back online. Fully assembled. Fully staffed — by things wearing crew uniforms. Every dead station in this system returns. Destroyed, demolished, vaporized — they reassemble. Something needs them.

levels.name: Revenant Dock
levels.description: A docking station that was blown apart during a war. Its pieces crawled back together over decades. The welds are organic. The hull breathes.
levels.theme: A reassembled station with organic seams between scrap metal, hull sections breathing in slow rhythm

levels.name: The Boneyard Risen
levels.description: A ship graveyard where every wreck has reactivated. Engines fire in unison. Navigation systems plot courses to nowhere. The dead fleet wants to fly.
levels.theme: A graveyard of reactivated wrecks, engines glowing, navigation systems blinking, dead ships twitching to life

levels.name: Assembly
levels.description: Where the reassembly happens. Scrap metal flows toward a central point like iron to a magnet. New stations form from the corpses of old ones.
levels.theme: A station under active construction from scrap, metal flowing and fusing autonomously, new forms growing from old wreckage

levels.name: Ward of Returns
levels.description: A medical station where dead crew are being rebuilt. Not resurrected — reassembled. Bones reset, skin re-draped. They walk but don't think.
levels.theme: A medical station performing grotesque reassembly of dead crew, bodies on tables in various stages of reconstruction

levels.name: The Resurrector
levels.description: Whatever is bringing things back lives here. A biomechanical core that refuses to let anything stay dead. Its purpose is older than the stations it rebuilds.
levels.theme: A pulsing biomechanical heart at the system's center, tendrils reaching through space, dragging dead things back to function

levels.name: The Truly Dead
levels.description: One station that hasn't come back. Scorched to atoms, scattered so thoroughly that even the Resurrector can't find the pieces. What killed it so completely?
levels.theme: An empty coordinate where a station should be, surrounded by stations that returned — a conspicuous absence

boss.name: The Revenant
boss.description: Dead station given purpose — guards its own rebirth

weapon.name: Seam Ripper
weapon.description: Tears apart organic welds like sutures

armor.name: Revenant Plate
armor.description: Armor that slowly repairs itself

designs.victory_message: The organic welds dissolve. The dock falls apart and stays apart.
designs.defeat_message: The dock breathes you in. You become another seam in the hull.

boss.name: Admiral Carrion
boss.description: Dead admiral commanding a dead fleet to war

weapon.name: Fleet Killer
weapon.description: Designed to destroy ships that won't stay dead

armor.name: Boneyard Scrap Armor
armor.description: Welded from wreck hull fragments

designs.victory_message: The fleet powers down for the last time. Admiral Carrion's bridge goes dark.
designs.defeat_message: The dead fleet launches. You are its newest crew member.

boss.name: The Assembler
boss.description: Mindless force that builds without plan or purpose

weapon.name: Magnetic Disruptor
weapon.description: Scatters reassembling metal

armor.name: Anti-Magnetic Shell
armor.description: Resists the pull toward assembly

designs.victory_message: The magnetic core shatters. Scrap falls and stays fallen.
designs.defeat_message: You are assembled into the station. A new rivet. A new bolt.

boss.name: Nurse Revive
boss.description: Rebuilds the dead with loving broken care

weapon.name: Mercy Cutter
weapon.description: Gives the reassembled their final rest

armor.name: Ward Scrubs Reinforced
armor.description: Medical gear hardened for combat

designs.victory_message: The reassembly tables stop. The dead stay dead. Nurse Revive weeps without eyes.
designs.defeat_message: Nurse Revive lays you on the table. The reassembly is loving, thorough, and wrong.

boss.name: The Resurrector
boss.description: Ancient engine of return — keeping everything alive against its will

weapon.name: Entropy Lance
weapon.description: The only weapon that kills permanently here

armor.name: Resurrector Carapace
armor.description: Biomechanical plating that regenerates

designs.victory_message: The heart stops beating. Things can finally stay dead.
designs.defeat_message: The Resurrector claims you. You die and return, die and return, forever.

boss.name: The Absence
boss.description: The memory of what killed a station so thoroughly

weapon.name: Absolute End
weapon.description: A weapon of total destruction — nothing returns

armor.name: Void Survivor Suit
armor.description: Worn by whoever witnessed the true death

designs.victory_message: The absence remains. Some things shouldn't come back. This is proof.
designs.defeat_message: You fill the absence. The station returns around you, rebuilt and wrong.

overworld.name: Gossamer
overworld.description: Filaments thinner than hair span the void between stations — thousands of kilometers of thread finer than spider silk. They carry data, power, gravity. Cut one and a station drifts into the dark. Walk the threads and you walk between worlds. The web is ancient. The spider is patient.

levels.name: Thread Anchor
levels.description: Where the first filament attaches to solid structure. The anchor point is encrusted with crystallized void-frost. The thread stretches into nothing.
levels.theme: An anchor station where gossamer threads converge, encrusted with void-frost crystals, threads humming with tension

levels.name: The Span
levels.description: A station built along a single filament. Rooms hang from the thread like dewdrops. Walk too heavily and the thread oscillates. Everything swings.
levels.theme: A station strung along a single thread, rooms dangling like ornaments, everything swaying with movement

levels.name: Weaver's Loom
levels.description: Where new threads are spun. The material comes from somewhere deeper — extruded from a biological source. The loom is alive.
levels.theme: A living loom station that spins new filaments from biological material, organic machinery pulsing with creation

levels.name: The Tangled
levels.description: A knot in the web where dozens of threads cross. Stations overlap, rooms from different structures sharing space. The geometry is impossible.
levels.theme: A knotted nexus of overlapping stations, rooms from different structures intersecting, impossible shared spaces

levels.name: The Spider's Rest
levels.description: Center of the web. Something vast and patient waits here, tending threads that span light-years. It has been building this web since before humanity reached the stars.
levels.theme: The ancient heart of the web, a vast biological nest where something immense tends threads that stretch across star systems

levels.name: Severed End
levels.description: A station whose threads were cut. It drifts in darkness, slowly spinning, its inhabitants trapped in a world disconnected from everything.
levels.theme: A cut-loose station drifting in the void, severed thread-ends trailing, spinning slowly in absolute isolation

boss.name: Anchor Keeper Thess
boss.description: Protects the convergence point with her life

weapon.name: Thread Cutter
weapon.description: Severs gossamer filaments with precision

armor.name: Anchor Keeper Coat
armor.description: Insulated against void-frost

designs.victory_message: The anchor holds. The threads hum with restored tension.
designs.defeat_message: You fall from the anchor. The threads catch no one.

boss.name: Pendulum
boss.description: A creature of momentum that lives in the sway

weapon.name: Momentum Blade
weapon.description: Stronger the faster you move

armor.name: Dewdrop Shell
armor.description: Armor shaped like a teardrop — aerodynamic

designs.victory_message: The span stabilizes. The dewdrop rooms hang still and peaceful.
designs.defeat_message: The oscillation grows. You swing wider and wider until the thread snaps.

boss.name: The Spinneress
boss.description: Biological thread-maker enslaved to the web

weapon.name: Loom Breaker
weapon.description: Disrupts the spinning mechanism

armor.name: Spun Silk Armor
armor.description: Gossamer-thread plating — light and strong

designs.victory_message: The loom stops spinning. The Spinneress rests for the first time.
designs.defeat_message: The loom wraps you in thread. You become raw material for new filaments.

boss.name: The Gordian
boss.description: Intelligence born from tangled impossibility

weapon.name: Knot Splitter
weapon.description: Axe that unravels impossible geometries

armor.name: Tangle-Proof Plate
armor.description: Armor that refuses to be knotted

designs.victory_message: The knot loosens. Stations pull apart to their proper positions.
designs.defeat_message: You become part of the knot. Your body occupies three rooms at once.

boss.name: The Gossamer Architect
boss.description: Ancient spider-god tending a web of worlds

weapon.name: Architect's Fang
weapon.description: Venom dissolves both flesh and filament

armor.name: Web-Heart Carapace
armor.description: Armor grown from the web's core material

designs.victory_message: The spider rests. The web remains — but nothing tends it now.
designs.defeat_message: The Architect wraps you in silk. You hang in the web, preserved forever.

boss.name: Castaway Wren
boss.description: Last survivor of the severed station

weapon.name: Severance Blade
weapon.description: Cuts cleanly and permanently

armor.name: Castaway Suit
armor.description: Survival gear for the permanently lost

designs.victory_message: A new thread finds the station. Connection restored after years of nothing.
designs.defeat_message: The threads were your only way back. Now you drift too.

overworld.name: ThessalyRift
overworld.description: A wound in spacetime that never healed. Stations here exist in multiple timelines at once — you can see yesterday's corridors overlapping with tomorrow's ruins. Past and future crew walk the same halls, unaware of each other. Sometimes you meet yourself. Sometimes you have to kill yourself. Time is broken and it's getting worse.

levels.name: Rift Edge
levels.description: The boundary where normal time frays. Clocks run at different speeds on different walls. Your shadow arrives before you do.
levels.theme: A station at the edge of broken time, clocks showing different hours on every surface, shadows misaligned from their sources

levels.name: Yesterday's Station
levels.description: A station stuck twelve hours in the past. Everything that happens here has already happened. You can see your own footprints from the future.
levels.theme: A station trapped in yesterday, events replaying, future footprints already visible in the dust

levels.name: The Chronoworks
levels.description: Someone tried to repair time here. The tools are scattered, half-finished temporal clamps and reality staples. They failed. The attempt made things worse.
levels.theme: A temporal repair workshop with half-built time clamps, scattered chronometric tools, and a rift that grew instead of closing

levels.name: Paradox Chamber
levels.description: A station where cause and effect have divorced. Pull a lever and the result happened an hour ago. Die and your corpse was here yesterday. Logic is optional.
levels.theme: A station where causality is broken — effects precede causes, corpses appear before deaths, doors open before they're touched

levels.name: The Rift Core
levels.description: The wound itself. Spacetime is torn open and you can see through the gap. Every timeline is visible — every version of these stations, every possible outcome. At the center, someone is holding the rift open.
levels.theme: The gaping wound in spacetime, timelines visible through the tear like pages of a book, a figure at the center holding reality apart

levels.name: Tomorrow's Ruin
levels.description: A station from the future where everything went wrong. It hasn't been built yet but it's already destroyed. Walking here shows you what's coming.
levels.theme: A future ruin that hasn't been built yet — advanced technology already crumbling, warnings written in languages not yet invented

boss.name: Warden Tick
boss.description: Keeps the boundary from fraying further

weapon.name: Temporal Blade
weapon.description: Cuts through time-locked defenses

armor.name: Rift Edge Guard Vest
armor.description: Stabilizes the wearer's personal timeline

designs.victory_message: The clocks align. For one moment, the rift edge holds steady.
designs.defeat_message: Your shadow catches up and passes you. You follow it into yesterday.

boss.name: Echo of Yourself
boss.description: You from twelve hours ago — confused and hostile

weapon.name: Hindsight Edge
weapon.description: Stronger against enemies you've seen before

armor.name: Yesterday's Armor
armor.description: Worn in. Comfortable. Already saved your life once

designs.victory_message: Yesterday ends. The station enters the present, trembling and new.
designs.defeat_message: You become yesterday. Stuck in a loop of twelve hours, forever.

boss.name: Dr. Tempus Wren
boss.description: Brilliant chrononaut whose repairs tore time wider

weapon.name: Chrono Hammer
weapon.description: Each strike rewinds the impact point by seconds

armor.name: Temporal Clamp Armor
