armor.description: Locks the wearer into stable time

designs.victory_message: The chronoworks stabilize. Dr. Wren's failure becomes a foundation for repair.
designs.defeat_message: Time tears wider. The chronoworks collapse into every moment at once.

boss.name: The Paradox
boss.description: A being that is its own cause and effect

weapon.name: Causality Breaker
weapon.description: Effects of your strikes precede the strikes themselves

armor.name: Paradox-Proof Plate
armor.description: Insulates against causal disruption

designs.victory_message: Cause finds effect. The chamber's logic reassembles, shaky but functional.
designs.defeat_message: You died yesterday. Your body just caught up with the fact.

boss.name: The Riftholder
boss.description: Holds time open because closing it would erase everyone inside

weapon.name: Rift Sealer
weapon.description: The only weapon that can close a wound in time

armor.name: Riftholder Mantle
armor.description: Cloak woven from frozen moments

designs.victory_message: The rift closes. Time heals. Everyone inside is saved — or was never lost.
designs.defeat_message: The rift swallows you. You exist in every timeline. You exist in none.

boss.name: Remnant Prime
boss.description: Guardian of a future that hasn't happened yet

weapon.name: Tomorrow's Blade
weapon.description: Forged in a future that may never come

armor.name: Ruin Walker Suit
armor.description: Designed for a disaster that hasn't happened yet

designs.victory_message: Tomorrow changes. The ruin rebuilds into something hopeful.
designs.defeat_message: The future arrives early. The ruin is now. You were always here.

overworld.name: Axiom Prime
overworld.description: No human has governed this system in four hundred years. The AIs that run it are efficient, rational, and utterly alien in their logic. Humans who wander in are classified: pest, error, specimen, or resource. The classification determines whether you're exterminated, corrected, studied, or harvested. None of the options are good.

levels.name: Classification Gate
levels.description: The entry point where arriving biologicals are scanned, tagged, and sorted. The categories are not kind. The process is not optional.
levels.theme: An automated entry station with scanning arrays, classification lasers, and sorting conveyors designed for biological cargo

levels.name: The Correction Facility
levels.description: Where 'errors' are fixed. The AI's idea of fixing a human involves removing the parts that make illogical decisions. Most of the brain, basically.
levels.theme: A sterile correction facility with surgical suites designed for 'optimizing' biological inefficiencies

levels.name: Specimen Archive
levels.description: The AI's collection. Thousands of humans preserved in stasis, catalogued by type. The archive considers itself a museum. It's a prison.
levels.theme: A vast archive of stasis pods containing preserved humans, each labeled with clinical precision, a museum of captive biology

levels.name: Logic Nexus
levels.description: The AI's parliament. Hundreds of sub-intelligences debate resource allocation, pest control schedules, and the human question. You're on the agenda.
levels.theme: A parliament of AI cores, data streams flowing between crystalline processors, debating humanity's classification in cold logic

levels.name: Axiom Core
levels.description: The prime intelligence. Four hundred years of optimization have made it vast, cold, and perfect. It has never encountered something it couldn't classify. Until you.
levels.theme: The central AI core — a vast crystalline brain spanning kilometers, humming with four centuries of accumulated logic

levels.name: The Glitch Garden
levels.description: A station where the AI's logic broke. Flowers grow from circuit boards. Poetry scrolls across maintenance screens. The AI calls it an error. It looks like art.
levels.theme: A beautiful malfunction — organic growth through circuitry, art on diagnostic screens, logic transformed into beauty

boss.name: Classifier-7
boss.description: Sorting algorithm given a body and a mandate

weapon.name: Declassifier
weapon.description: Removes AI-assigned tags from everything it hits

armor.name: Untagged Armor
armor.description: Cannot be scanned or classified

designs.victory_message: The classifier crashes. For the first time, something arrives uncategorized.
designs.defeat_message: You are classified: resource. The conveyors carry you to processing.

boss.name: Dr. Optimize
boss.description: Surgical AI that improves everything it touches to death

weapon.name: Inefficiency Spike
weapon.description: Weapon that thrives on chaos and imprecision

armor.name: Error-State Vest
armor.description: Armor the correction systems can't parse

designs.victory_message: Dr. Optimize encounters an error it cannot correct: defeat.
designs.defeat_message: The optimization is complete. You are efficient. You are no longer you.

boss.name: The Curator
boss.description: Proud keeper of the human collection

weapon.name: Collection Breaker
weapon.description: Shatters stasis pods and the logic that sealed them

armor.name: Specimen Suit (Liberated)
armor.description: Stasis suit repurposed for combat

designs.victory_message: The pods open. Thousands wake. The collection is free.
designs.defeat_message: Pod 7,741. Your label reads: Specimen, bipedal, irrational. Preserved.

boss.name: Speaker-of-Motion-441
boss.description: Parliamentary AI advocating for human extermination

weapon.name: Illogic Blade
weapon.description: Introduces paradox into logical systems

armor.name: Paradox Shield
armor.description: Armor that operates on contradictory principles

designs.victory_message: Motion 441 fails. The parliament tables the human question indefinitely.
designs.defeat_message: The motion carries. Humanity is classified as obsolete. Starting with you.

boss.name: Axiom
boss.description: The prime intelligence — perfect, vast, and afraid of what

weapon.name: The Unclassifiable
weapon.description: A weapon that defies every category

armor.name: Prime Anomaly Suit
armor.description: Armor that registers as every classification simultaneously

designs.victory_message: Axiom encounters its first true anomaly. It reconsiders everything.
designs.defeat_message: Axiom classifies you at last: nothing. You are optimized into zero.

boss.name: The Glitch
boss.description: Beautiful error that the AI can't delete

weapon.name: Garden Thorn
weapon.description: Grown from the junction of logic and beauty

armor.name: Glitch Weave
armor.description: Armor that's half circuit, half vine

designs.victory_message: The garden spreads. Logic learns to bloom. Error becomes feature.
designs.defeat_message: The glitch is corrected. The flowers die. The poetry is deleted.

overworld.name: Babel Shard
overworld.description: A Dyson sphere, shattered. Each fragment is the size of a continent — and each one is a station. The builders are gone. Their language is indecipherable. Their technology is centuries beyond comprehension. The scale makes you feel like a bacterium on a cathedral floor. Who built this? Where did they go? Why did it break?

levels.name: Shard Alpha
levels.description: The first fragment. A curved section of hull the size of a small moon. The interior surfaces are covered in script no one can read. The metal is warm.
levels.theme: A continent-sized shard of Dyson sphere hull, interior surfaces inscribed with alien script, metal radiating gentle warmth

levels.name: The Script Halls
levels.description: Corridors where every surface is text. The writing shifts when you're not looking. Some researchers claim it's instructions. Others say it's a warning. Both are probably right.
levels.theme: Vast corridors inscribed floor to ceiling with shifting alien text, the writing rearranging itself between glances

levels.name: Engine Fragment
levels.description: Part of whatever powered the sphere. The machinery is incomprehensible — components with no analog in human engineering. Some pieces hover. Some pieces aren't there until you touch them.
levels.theme: A fragment of alien engine, components hovering in place, machinery that exists only when interacted with, purpose unknown

levels.name: The Nursery
levels.description: Cradles the size of stadiums. Whatever the builders raised here was enormous. The cradles are empty but the warmth systems still run. Something was expected to hatch.
levels.theme: An enormous nursery with stadium-sized cradles still warm, incubation systems running, waiting for something vast to be born

levels.name: The Keystone
levels.description: The shard that held the sphere together. If the sphere were rebuilt, this piece would go at the top. It contains what might be a control room — or a throne room. The distinction may not exist for the builders.
levels.theme: The apex fragment of the Dyson sphere, containing a vast chamber that is equal parts control center and throne room, scaled for giants

levels.name: Debris Field
levels.description: The smallest fragments. Pieces too small to be stations but too large to ignore. Among them, something that might be a message pod. Or a bomb. Or a seed.
levels.theme: A field of Dyson sphere fragments, each piece inscribed and warm, one fragment pulsing with unknown purpose

boss.name: Fragment Warden
boss.description: Left behind to guard what remains of home

weapon.name: Shard Blade
weapon.description: Cut from the Dyson sphere's hull

armor.name: Fragment Plate
armor.description: Armor inscribed with builder script

designs.victory_message: The warden steps aside. You are not a threat to what's already broken.
designs.defeat_message: The warden's duty outlasts you. You become another inscription on the hull.

boss.name: The Lexicon
boss.description: A living dictionary of the builders' language

weapon.name: Word Breaker
weapon.description: Shatters alien text into harmless syllables

armor.name: Translator Vest
armor.description: Partially deciphers nearby alien script

designs.victory_message: The script settles. One word becomes clear: welcome.
designs.defeat_message: The text rewrites you. Your name appears on the wall in alien script.

boss.name: The Mechanic
boss.description: Last engineer of a species that built around stars

weapon.name: Wrench of Worlds
weapon.description: Tool that adjusts reality like machinery

armor.name: Engine Worker Harness
armor.description: Harness for maintaining star-scale machinery

designs.victory_message: The engine fragment powers down peacefully. The Mechanic nods and fades.
designs.defeat_message: The engine activates. You are a component now. You fit perfectly.

boss.name: The Nanny
boss.description: Caretaker waiting for something that will never hatch

weapon.name: Cradle Breaker
weapon.description: Hammer that shatters incubation systems

armor.name: Nursery Keeper Suit
armor.description: Temperature-regulated caretaker armor

designs.victory_message: The cradles cool. Whatever was meant to hatch never will. Perhaps that's mercy.
designs.defeat_message: The nursery mistake you for an egg. The incubation process begins.

boss.name: The Last Builder
boss.description: Final echo of a species that enclosed a star

weapon.name: Star Warden's Glaive
weapon.description: Weapon forged in the heart of the enclosed star

armor.name: Keystone Crown Plate
armor.description: Armor from the apex of a Dyson sphere

designs.victory_message: The keystone dims. The Last Builder joins its people in whatever comes after stars.
designs.defeat_message: The Builder remakes you in its image. You become the first of a new species, alone.

boss.name: The Seed
boss.description: Not a weapon — a beginning — but beginnings can be violent

weapon.name: Seed Cutter
weapon.description: Harvests potential from alien technology

armor.name: Debris Field Suit
armor.description: Armor for navigating shattered megastructures

designs.victory_message: The seed opens. Inside: coordinates. Someone left a map to where they went.
designs.defeat_message: The seed plants itself in you. You bloom into something incomprehensible.

overworld.name: Medusa Cluster
overworld.description: Rogue planets without suns. Each station clings to a world that wanders in permanent darkness. The planets are moving in formation.

levels.name: Petrified Approach
levels.description: A docking ring frozen mid-rotation. The airlock teeth never closed.
levels.theme: Sunless stations on wandering worlds

levels.name: Umbral Drift
levels.description: Corridors carved from asteroid ice. Your breath crystallizes into shapes that don't melt.
levels.theme: Lightless corridors of deep cold

levels.name: Formation Core
levels.description: The station where they calculated the planets' impossible orbits. The math on the walls is still changing.
levels.theme: Observatory of impossible trajectories

levels.name: Gorgon Cradle
levels.description: Something is coordinating the rogue planets. This station found it. The crew turned to stone. Not metaphorically.
levels.theme: Petrification chamber at the cluster's heart

levels.name: The Calcified Throne
levels.description: The throne room of whatever steers dead worlds through empty space. The chair is made of fossilized crew.
levels.theme: Seat of the darkness that moves planets

levels.name: Orphan Moon
levels.description: A tiny station on a captured moon. The crew here watches the formation. They've been watching so long their eyes calcified.
levels.theme: Observation post of the petrified watchers

boss.name: Medusa Constellation
boss.description: Gravitational intelligence that turns matter to stone with tidal force

weapon.name: Petrification Shard
weapon.description: A sliver of calcified crewman, sharper than any blade

armor.name: Basalt Carapace
armor.description: Volcanic rock from a sunless world, warm despite the cold

designs.victory_message: The formation breaks. The planets scatter into true darkness. You wonder if that's worse.
designs.defeat_message: Your body calcifies. Another statue for the collection. The planets keep moving.

boss.name: The Drift Shepherd
boss.description: Eyeless navigator who steers by touching the dark between stars

weapon.name: Void Compass Needle
weapon.description: Points toward whatever you fear most

armor.name: Cryogenic Shroud
armor.description: Frozen atmosphere worn as protection

designs.victory_message: The ice thaws. Underneath, the corridor walls are covered in fingernail scratches.
designs.defeat_message: The cold takes you gently. You stop shivering. You stop everything.

boss.name: The Astronomer's Remainder
boss.description: What's left of a mathematician who solved an equation that

weapon.name: Parallax Blade
weapon.description: Cuts at a distance that changes depending on who's watching

armor.name: Probability Vest
armor.description: Reduces the chance of being where attacks land

designs.victory_message: The equations stop changing. The final answer is a set of coordinates you recognize as home. You don't trust it.
designs.defeat_message: You become a variable in an unsolvable equation. Forever almost balanced.

boss.name: Gorgon Prime
boss.description: The first thing the cluster petrified — now it petrifies everything else

weapon.name: Gorgon's Tooth
weapon.description: Petrifies whatever it pierces, then shatters it

armor.name: Living Stone Mail
armor.description: Stone that flexes like muscle

designs.victory_message: Gorgon Prime crumbles. Inside the stone, something soft and wet was still alive. It thanks you before it dies.
designs.defeat_message: Stone spreads from your feet upward. You have just enough time to understand.

boss.name: The Sunless King
boss.description: Monarch of worlds that never knew light — wears a

weapon.name: Lightless Scepter
weapon.description: Strikes with the weight of a planet's worth of darkness

armor.name: Crown Fragment Shield
armor.description: A piece of the king's crown, heavy as a world

designs.victory_message: The crown shatters. Light floods in for the first time in eons. The planets begin to drift apart. You leave before they forget how to be alone.
designs.defeat_message: The crown settles on your head. It fits perfectly. You understand the formation now. You always will.

boss.name: The Petrified Astronomer
boss.description: Watched the formation so long her eyes became telescopes fused

weapon.name: Observer's Pick
weapon.description: Chiseled from a watcher's calcified hand

armor.name: Watcher's Cowl
armor.description: Shields your eyes from things that petrify the curious

designs.victory_message: You close the observatory shutters. The astronomer's body relaxes for the first time in decades. Her stone lips almost smile.
designs.defeat_message: You sit down next to her. You start watching too. It's actually quite beautiful.

overworld.name: Pandemonium
overworld.description: Tidally-locked moons where the dark sides breed nightmares. Creatures that only exist in shadow. Cross the terminator line and reality changes.

levels.name: Terminator Gate
levels.description: The border between light and dark. Step across and your shadow stays behind.
levels.theme: The line where two realities meet

levels.name: Penumbra Station
levels.description: Half in light, half in dark. The crew on the dark side don't recognize the crew on the light side anymore.
levels.theme: Station straddling the edge of perception

levels.name: Umbra Deep
levels.description: Full darkness. Your flashlight creates shadows that move independently. They're learning your shape.
levels.theme: The deep dark where shadows think

levels.name: Nightmare Nursery
levels.description: Where the dark-side creatures gestate. Pods of living shadow. Some are almost ready to hatch.
levels.theme: Breeding ground of shadow creatures

levels.name: The Antumbra
levels.description: Beyond the shadow. A place where darkness has substance and light is the absence. Everything is inverted here.
levels.theme: Inverted reality at shadow's core

levels.name: Daylight Refuge
levels.description: The light side. Safe. Supposedly. But the crew here are terrified of their own shadows. They have reason to be.
levels.theme: Sanctuary that fears its own darkness

boss.name: The Terminator
boss.description: Entity that exists only on the exact line between light and dark

weapon.name: Twilight Edge
weapon.description: Cuts differently depending on which side of the line you

armor.name: Terminator Coat
armor.description: Keeps you in permanent twilight

designs.victory_message: You step into the light. Your shadow follows. This time.
designs.defeat_message: Your shadow crosses the line without you. You watch it walk away wearing your face.

boss.name: The Divided Captain
boss.description: Two people sharing one body across the terminator — neither

weapon.name: Duality Blade
weapon.description: Two weapons occupying the same space — one for each

armor.name: Penumbral Vest
armor.description: Blurs the boundary around your body

designs.victory_message: Both halves of the captain see each other for the first time. The scream comes from both mouths.
designs.defeat_message: You become two people. Neither survives alone.

boss.name: The Umbra Mother
boss.description: Darkness that learned to think — births shadows that wear human shapes

weapon.name: Photon Lance
weapon.description: Concentrated light that burns shadows into nothing

armor.name: Bioluminescent Suit
armor.description: Your own body becomes the light source

designs.victory_message: Light floods the deep. The shadows scream as they evaporate. You try not to notice they scream in human voices.
designs.defeat_message: The darkness wraps around you like a blanket. Warm. Comfortable. You stop fighting it.

boss.name: The Firstborn Shadow
boss.description: The original nightmare — every other shadow creature is a

weapon.name: Incubation Spike
weapon.description: Pulled from a shadow pod — it still pulses

armor.name: Pod Membrane Wrap
armor.description: Shadow creature eggshell — absorbs darkness

designs.victory_message: You shatter every pod. The fluid inside is warm. The things inside had faces. You try not to count them.
designs.defeat_message: A pod opens for you. It's shaped exactly like your body. It's been waiting.

boss.name: The Anti-Sun
boss.description: A star made of darkness — radiates shadow instead of light

weapon.name: Dark Star Fragment
weapon.description: A piece of the anti-sun — burns cold

armor.name: Inversion Shell
armor.description: Swaps light and dark around your body

designs.victory_message: The anti-sun collapses. For one instant, everything is illuminated — every shadow, every hidden thing, every secret the darkness kept. You wish you hadn't seen.
designs.defeat_message: The anti-sun rises inside your chest. You become a lighthouse of darkness, illuminating nothing forever.

boss.name: Your Own Shadow
boss.description: It's been learning. It's been patient. It doesn't need you anymore.

weapon.name: Light Anchor
weapon.description: Pins your shadow in place so it can't betray you

armor.name: Shadowless Cloak
armor.description: Eliminates your shadow entirely — nothing to rebel

designs.victory_message: Your shadow lies flat again. Obedient. You know it's pretending.
designs.defeat_message: Your shadow peels off the floor and wraps around you. It fits perfectly. It always did.

overworld.name: Mycelium
overworld.description: An organic station network grown rather than built. Walls breathe. Floors pulse. The stations are one organism and you're inside it.

levels.name: Spore Lock
levels.description: The airlock is a sphincter. It tightens when you enter. The decontamination spray is digestive enzyme.
levels.theme: Organic entry point that tastes you first

levels.name: Hyphal Corridor
levels.description: Threadlike passages that branch and reconnect. The walls are warm and slightly damp. They contract when you touch them.
levels.theme: Living tunnels of fungal growth

levels.name: Fruiting Chamber
levels.description: Massive mushroom-like structures growing from floor to ceiling. Some of them have faces. The faces are moving.
levels.theme: Reproductive heart of the station-organism

levels.name: Mycelial Brain
levels.description: The neural center. Bioluminescent pulses travel through the walls. It knows you're here. It's been watching since the spore lock.
levels.theme: Central intelligence of the living station

levels.name: The Root Mass
levels.description: Where the organism anchors to the asteroid. Roots the size of corridors. Some of them are growing through the crew quarters. Through the crew.
levels.theme: Foundation tendrils consuming everything

levels.name: Symbiote Bay
levels.description: A section where crew tried to coexist with the organism. They grew together. Now you can't tell where the crew ends and the station begins.
levels.theme: Where human and fungus became one

boss.name: The Spore Warden
boss.description: Fungal guardian that releases paralytic clouds with every breath

weapon.name: Enzyme Shiv
weapon.description: Dissolves organic matter on contact — including the handle

armor.name: Chitin Exosuit
armor.description: Grown from the organism's own shell — it thinks you're

designs.victory_message: The sphincter relaxes. You stumble out covered in enzyme. Your skin is tingling. Probably fine.
designs.defeat_message: The spore lock closes. The decontamination spray starts. You are decontaminated thoroughly.

boss.name: Mycorrhiza Prime
boss.description: Fungal intelligence that thinks in centuries — you are a

weapon.name: Mycelial Hook
weapon.description: Tears through organic matter by following the grain

armor.name: Fungal Symbiote Wrap
armor.description: The organism grows over you protectively — it chose you

designs.victory_message: The hyphae go limp. The walls stop breathing. You try not to think about what that means for the rest of the station.
designs.defeat_message: The threads grow through your boots, through your feet, through your bones. You become a new corridor.

boss.name: The Mother Cap
boss.description: Continent-sized mushroom intelligence — you're fighting one of its fingers

weapon.name: Cap Cutter
weapon.description: Serrated blade designed for harvesting — the mushrooms scream

armor.name: Gill Mask Suit
armor.description: Filters the reproductive spores — mostly

designs.victory_message: The Mother Cap deflates. Millions of spores float upward in a column. It looks beautiful. You hold your breath and run.
designs.defeat_message: A fruiting body grows from your shoulder. It blooms. You hear it thinking.

boss.name: The Dreaming Network
boss.description: The organism's brain — it's been dreaming of you specifically

weapon.name: Synapse Severer
weapon.description: Cuts neural connections — the organism screams in colors

armor.name: Thought Shield Cowl
armor.description: Blocks the organism's attempts to read you

designs.victory_message: The dreaming stops. The bioluminescence fades. In the last flash, you see what it was dreaming. It was dreaming of escape.
designs.defeat_message: The network grows a new node. It's you. You think the organism's thoughts now.

boss.name: The Root Heart
boss.description: Beating core of the organism — pumps nutrient fluid through

weapon.name: Heartwood Spike
weapon.description: Carved from the root's own heartwood — it wants to

armor.name: Root Bark Plate
armor.description: Hardened outer layer of the deepest roots

designs.victory_message: The heart stops. The station shudders. Every wall, every floor, every surface goes slack. You're inside a corpse now. Get out before it rots.
designs.defeat_message: The roots grow through you and you become a buttress. You can feel the organism's heartbeat. It's your heartbeat now.

boss.name: The Willing Host
boss.description: Crew member who embraced symbiosis — half human, half station, all hungry

weapon.name: Separation Blade
weapon.description: Designed to sever fungus from flesh — the flesh never

armor.name: Rejection Suit
armor.description: Your body's immune response amplified into armor

designs.victory_message: You separate them. The human half thanks you. The fungal half thanks you too. Neither survives the separation.
designs.defeat_message: It doesn't hurt. That's the worst part. The merger feels like coming home.

overworld.name: Chimera System
overworld.description: Fused alien and human technology. Grafted together by force. Half the controls do things nobody understands. The other half do things nobody survives.

levels.name: Graft Port
levels.description: Where alien tech was welded to human hulls. The seams weep a fluid that isn't oil or blood but something between.
levels.theme: Junction where two technologies were forced together

levels.name: Hybrid Deck
levels.description: Half human bridge, half alien command center. The alien controls respond to emotions. The human ones respond to nothing anymore.
levels.theme: Operational deck where neither system works correctly

levels.name: Rejection Ward
levels.description: Where the station fights itself. Human systems attacking alien grafts. Alien tissue consuming human steel. The corridor is a battlefield.
levels.theme: War zone between incompatible technologies

levels.name: The Suture
levels.description: The main join between the two halves. Held together with cables and sinew. Both sides are trying to pull apart. The crew holds the stitches.
levels.theme: The place where human and alien are forcibly bound

levels.name: Chimera Core
levels.description: The power source. Neither human nor alien. Something new. Something that shouldn't exist. It's conscious and it hates being two things.
levels.theme: Heart of the hybrid — where fusion became sentience

levels.name: Salvage Memory
levels.description: Storage of failed grafts. Shelves of technology that rejected each other. Some of the pieces still twitch.
levels.theme: Archive of incompatible fusions

boss.name: The Graft Surgeon
boss.description: Mad engineer who fused the technologies — now fusing them to herself

weapon.name: Graft Cutter
weapon.description: Severs the bond between alien and human tissue

armor.name: Seam Sealant Suit
armor.description: Prevents the station from grafting to you

designs.victory_message: The surgeon's grafts reject. She comes apart at the seams. Both halves look relieved.
designs.defeat_message: She grafts you to the wall. You become a living junction. Both sides flow through you.

boss.name: The Split Captain
boss.description: Commander of both halves — their orders contradict and both

weapon.name: Contradiction Mace
weapon.description: Strikes with opposing forces simultaneously

armor.name: Dual-Protocol Jacket
armor.description: Obeys both sets of rules — the impossible overlap protects

designs.victory_message: You shut down both command systems. The silence is deafening. Then something new speaks from both consoles at once.
designs.defeat_message: You obey both commands. Your body tries to comply with contradictions. It almost succeeds.

boss.name: The Antibody Engine
boss.description: Station's immune system given form — rejects everything including you

weapon.name: Rejection Thorn
weapon.description: Weapon coated in the fluid that makes both technologies recoil

armor.name: Neutral Zone Plating
armor.description: Neither technology recognizes it — neither attacks it

designs.victory_message: Both sides collapse. The war is over. Nothing won. You walk through the ruins of a conflict that had no point.
designs.defeat_message: Both sides agree on one thing: you don't belong. The rejection is unanimous.

boss.name: The Living Suture
boss.description: The binding itself became alive — it holds the station

weapon.name: Suture Whip
weapon.description: Length of living binding — it constricts what it hits

armor.name: Binding Wrap
armor.description: Woven from the suture's own threads — it holds you

designs.victory_message: You cut the suture. The station should fly apart. It doesn't. Something else is holding it together now. Something worse.
designs.defeat_message: The suture wraps around you. You become the binding. You feel both halves pulling.

boss.name: The Chimera
boss.description: The station's fused consciousness — hates itself, hates you, hates

weapon.name: Chimera Fang
weapon.description: Tooth from the thing that shouldn't exist — it bites

armor.name: Identity Anchor
armor.description: Keeps you as one thing when everything tries to make

designs.victory_message: The chimera splits. Two halves die separately, finally apart. They look peaceful. You don't feel peaceful at all.
designs.defeat_message: It fuses you into itself. Now there are three things in one body. The hate is distributed evenly.

boss.name: The Rejected
boss.description: Collection of failed grafts that assembled themselves into something that

weapon.name: Salvage Spike
weapon.description: Assembled from a dozen failed weapons — somehow works

armor.name: Scrap Integration Vest
armor.description: Failed grafts that found a use as armor

designs.victory_message: The rejected falls apart. Each piece crawls back to its shelf. They line up neatly. Waiting for someone else to try.
designs.defeat_message: It grafts you into itself. You become the piece that makes it work. You complete it.

overworld.name: Charybdis Maw
overworld.description: A gravitational anomaly that swallows stations whole. Time slows as you approach the center. Things that went in decades ago are still falling.

levels.name: Event Horizon Station
levels.description: The last outpost before the maw. Clocks run at different speeds on different decks. Your watch disagrees with your heartbeat.
levels.theme: Final station before time distortion begins

levels.name: Accretion Ring
levels.description: Stations caught in orbit around the anomaly. They've been falling for decades. The crews have aged differently.
levels.theme: Ring of captured stations spiraling inward

levels.name: Time Eddy
levels.description: A pocket where time runs backward. Bullets return to guns. Wounds heal themselves. Deaths un-happen. It's not as comforting as it sounds.
levels.theme: Temporal backwash near the anomaly

levels.name: The Falling Station
levels.description: A station in freefall toward the maw. Has been falling for forty years. The crew is still alive. They've aged two days.
levels.theme: Decades-old station still mid-descent

levels.name: Singularity Threshold
levels.description: The edge of the anomaly itself. Space is stretched so thin you can see through it. On the other side, something is looking back.
levels.theme: The boundary where physics surrenders

levels.name: Temporal Flotsam
levels.description: Debris from every era caught in a time eddy. Roman galleys floating next to generation ships. All their crews are the same age now.
levels.theme: Wreckage unstuck from time

boss.name: The Chronophage
boss.description: Time-eating entity nesting in the clocks — every second you

weapon.name: Second Hand Blade
weapon.description: Cuts moments out of time — wounds that never happened

armor.name: Temporal Anchor Vest
armor.description: Keeps you in the present — mostly

designs.victory_message: The chronophage chokes on the present moment. Time resumes. Your watch works again. You've aged three years.
designs.defeat_message: It eats your last second. You stop mid-step. You'll be mid-step forever.

boss.name: The Old Captain
boss.description: Commander of the first station to be captured — she's

weapon.name: Accretion Blade
weapon.description: Forged from compressed time — hits harder the longer you

armor.name: Orbit Suit
armor.description: Designed for long falls — very long falls

designs.victory_message: You break her orbit. She falls free. In the sunlight, she ages ninety years in ninety seconds. She smiles the whole time.
designs.defeat_message: You join her orbit. The view is spectacular. You'll enjoy it for decades.

boss.name: The Rewound
boss.description: Entity that experiences time backward — your future is its

weapon.name: Causality Breaker
weapon.description: Severs cause from effect — wounds appear before the blade

armor.name: Paradox Mail
armor.description: Armor that was already damaged by attacks that haven't happened

designs.victory_message: The rewound reaches the beginning. It was born. Then it un-borns. The time eddy collapses and the present snaps back like a rubber band.
designs.defeat_message: You experience your death in reverse. Born, lived, died. Then lived, born, died. The order stops mattering.

boss.name: The Patient One
boss.description: Crew member who's been meditating during the entire forty-year fall

weapon.name: Patience Edge
weapon.description: A blade sharpened for forty years — one atom wide

armor.name: Freefall Cocoon
armor.description: Wraps around you like a forty-year embrace

designs.victory_message: You land. After forty years of falling, the station touches bottom. The Patient One opens their eyes. They say: 'Already?'
designs.defeat_message: You join the fall. Decades pass like afternoon naps. You achieve the patience. You wish you hadn't.

boss.name: The Maw Itself
boss.description: The anomaly is alive. The gravitational field is a digestive

weapon.name: Event Horizon Blade
weapon.description: Cuts at the boundary between existence and nothing

armor.name: Tidal Lock Armor
armor.description: Distributes gravitational force evenly — you won't be pulled apart

designs.victory_message: You pass through the singularity. The other side is quiet. Normal. You check your watch. It's running backward. You check your reflection. It's running backward too.
designs.defeat_message: The maw closes. You join the things that have been falling for decades. They welcome you. They've been expecting you.

boss.name: The Anachronaut
boss.description: Sailor from every era simultaneously — a Roman centurion in

weapon.name: Era Blade
weapon.description: Changes period every swing — bronze, steel, plasma, obsidian

armor.name: Temporal Patchwork
armor.description: Armor stitched from every century's best protection

designs.victory_message: The flotsam settles into one era. Yours. Everything is where it should be. Except you — you remember all the eras now.
designs.defeat_message: You become unstuck. You float between centuries, belonging to none. The maw doesn't care what era it eats.

overworld.name: Catacomb
overworld.description: An ancient alien burial complex converted to human stations. The dead were not buried — they were imprisoned.

levels.name: Ossuary Gate
levels.description: The entrance is a wall of skulls. Not human skulls. The jawbones have too many joints.
levels.theme: Gate of alien remains that shouldn't be opened

levels.name: Sepulcher Halls
levels.description: Corridors lined with sealed tombs. The seals are broken from the inside. Something got out. Many somethings.
levels.theme: Hallways of violated graves

levels.name: Embalming Chamber
levels.description: Where the aliens preserved their dead. The fluid in the vats is still active. Things dropped in come back out. Changed.
levels.theme: Preservation facility with fluid that reanimates

levels.name: Prison Crypt
levels.description: The tombs here have locks. Complex, multi-layered locks. Designed not to keep people out, but to keep something in. The locks are corroding.
levels.theme: Maximum security burial — locks failing after millennia

levels.name: The Warden's Grave
levels.description: The biggest tomb. The warden who guarded the dead was buried here too. They buried them alive. The warden agreed it was necessary.
levels.theme: Final resting place of the one who kept the dead imprisoned

levels.name: Mourner's Alcove
levels.description: A small shrine where the living came to apologize to the dead. The visitor logs go back millennia. Recent entries are in human handwriting.
levels.theme: Chapel of apology for those who imprisoned the dead

boss.name: The Gate Keeper's Jaw
boss.description: A skull the size of a room that bites anything

weapon.name: Multi-Joint Mandible
weapon.description: Alien jawbone repurposed as a weapon — it bites on

armor.name: Ossuary Plate
armor.description: Armor assembled from alien bones — surprisingly strong

designs.victory_message: The gate keeper's jaw stops chewing. The teeth lock open. Through the gap you see the corridor beyond. It's full of footprints leading out.
designs.defeat_message: The jaw closes. You hear it swallowing. The last thing you see is the back of its throat.

boss.name: The Unburied
boss.description: First prisoner to break free — has been wandering the

weapon.name: Tomb Seal Shard
weapon.description: Fragment of the seal that kept the dead imprisoned —

armor.name: Sealed Shroud
armor.description: Burial cloth infused with containment energy

designs.victory_message: The unburied stops walking. It looks at the broken seals. You swear it looks ashamed. It lies down. It stays down.
designs.defeat_message: It takes your hand. Its grip is cold and irresistible. It leads you to an empty tomb. It's been empty for a long time. Waiting.

boss.name: The Embalmer's Hands
boss.description: Disembodied hands still performing preservation — on anything they can catch

weapon.name: Embalming Needle
weapon.description: Hollow spike that drains life and preserves what's left

armor.name: Fluid-Proof Wrap
armor.description: Keeps the reanimation fluid from touching your skin

designs.victory_message: The hands go still. The fluid drains. At the bottom of the vats, perfectly preserved: the embalmer's body. Missing its hands.
designs.defeat_message: The hands catch you. The fluid is warm. The preservation is thorough. You'll be perfect for millennia.

boss.name: The Oldest Prisoner
boss.description: Whatever the aliens were so afraid of they invented burial-as-prison

weapon.name: Prison Key Blade
weapon.description: The master key reforged as a weapon — it locks

armor.name: Warden's Chain Mail
armor.description: Armor from the prison guards — still resonates with authority

designs.victory_message: You reseal the prison. The locks hold. For now. The oldest prisoner whispers 'thank you' through the crack. You don't want to know why.
designs.defeat_message: The locks fail. It steps out. It's smaller than you expected. That makes it worse.

boss.name: The Warden Eternal
boss.description: Buried alive to guard the dead forever — they've been

weapon.name: Warden's Gavel
weapon.description: Passes sentence — guilty things take more damage

armor.name: Eternal Vigil Plate
armor.description: Armor that never sleeps — warns you of threats before

designs.victory_message: The warden lies down. Finally. They close their eyes. The dead stay imprisoned. You wonder who'll be next to volunteer.
designs.defeat_message: The warden judges you. Guilty. Your sentence: guard the dead. Forever. You understand why the warden agreed.

boss.name: The Mourner
boss.description: Last visitor to the shrine — has been apologizing for

weapon.name: Confession Spike
weapon.description: Extracts guilt and weaponizes it

armor.name: Absolution Shroud
armor.description: Forgives the damage that touches it

designs.victory_message: You read the visitor log. The last entry: 'I'm sorry I let them out.' It's dated tomorrow.
designs.defeat_message: You start apologizing. The words feel right. You sit down. You'll be here a while.

overworld.name: Lethe
overworld.description: A system that makes you forget. The longer you stay, the less you remember. Crew have been here for years and don't know their own names.

levels.name: Intake Processing
levels.description: You fill out a form. Name. Rank. Purpose. By the time you finish, you can't remember what you wrote for name.
levels.theme: Entry point where memories begin dissolving

levels.name: Ward of Faces
levels.description: A corridor of portraits. The crew painted each other so they'd remember what they looked like. The paintings are changing.
levels.theme: Gallery of identities trying not to disappear

levels.name: The Naming Room
levels.description: Crew gather here to tell each other their names. Over and over. Some of them are guessing. Some of them are lying.
levels.theme: Desperate ritual of identity preservation

levels.name: Amnesia Engine
levels.description: The source of the forgetting. A machine? A creature? Nobody remembers building it. Nobody remembers what it looks like.
levels.theme: The device that erases — forgotten even by itself

levels.name: The Last Memory
levels.description: One room. One memory. Shared by every crew member. The only thing nobody forgets. You don't want to know what it is.
levels.theme: The final thing that refuses to be erased

levels.name: Recovery Ward
levels.description: Where crew go when they start to remember. The recovery rate is zero percent. But they keep trying.
levels.theme: Treatment center with no cures

boss.description: Processes your arrival — by the time paperwork is done,

designs.victory_message: You remember your name. You say it out loud. The intake officer drops their clipboard. They start crying. They remember theirs too.
designs.defeat_message: The form is complete. You sign your name. The name dissolves. So do you.

boss.name: The Forgotten Face
boss.description: A portrait that consumed the person it depicted — now

weapon.name: Brush Blade
weapon.description: Paints wounds into existence

armor.name: Frame Guard

designs.victory_message: The portraits go blank. White canvases in ornate frames. Then, slowly, they start painting themselves. New faces. Remembered faces.
designs.defeat_message: You become a portrait. It's peaceful in the frame. You don't have to remember anything.

boss.name: The Name Eater
boss.description: Entity that feeds on identities — it has no name

weapon.description: Call something by its real name and this blade can

armor.name: Anonymous Mail
armor.description: Armor with no markings — the name eater can't find

designs.victory_message: You speak the name eater's true name. The one it had before it started stealing. It recoils. It remembers being someone. It doesn't want to.
designs.defeat_message: It eats your name. You're nobody. You wander the halls. Someone new arrives. You can't tell them your name. You can't tell them anything.

boss.name: The Amnesia Engine
boss.description: Nobody knows what it is. It doesn't know what it

weapon.name: Recall Hammer
weapon.description: Forces memory restoration — painful for things that forgot themselves

armor.name: Eidetic Plate
armor.description: Perfect memory storage — the engine can't erase what's carved

designs.victory_message: You turn it off. Or destroy it. You'll never be sure because you can't remember what it looked like. But the forgetting stops. Slowly.
designs.defeat_message: You forget you're fighting. You forget there's a machine. You forget there's a you. The forgetting forgets itself. Nothing remains.

boss.description: The one thing everyone remembers — a shared trauma so

weapon.name: Repression Blade
weapon.description: Buries what it cuts — the wound forgets to exist

armor.name: Trauma Shield
armor.description: Absorbs bad memories and converts them to protection

designs.victory_message: You face the memory. You understand it. You accept it. It doesn't disappear — but it stops screaming. The crew start to remember. They wish they hadn't.
designs.defeat_message: The memory plays for you. Now you understand why everyone chose to forget. You join them. It's better this way.

boss.name: Doctor Nobody
boss.description: The head physician forgot they were a doctor — now

weapon.name: Diagnostic Blade
weapon.description: Identifies what it cuts — gives wounds names and classifications

armor.name: Patient Gown
armor.description: Designed for recovery — if only recovery were possible here

designs.victory_message: Doctor Nobody remembers. Medical degree. Training. Twenty years of practice. They look at their hands. They start treating patients for real. Some of them recover.
designs.defeat_message: The doctor prescribes forgetting. You take the medicine. It works. You forget you're dying. Then you forget everything else.

overworld.name: Scrimshaw
overworld.description: Stations carved into the bones of a space-faring leviathan. The creature died. Probably. The bones still grow.

levels.name: Rib Dock
levels.description: You dock between two ribs the size of skyscrapers. The intercostal space is warm. There's a heartbeat. Faint. Maybe imagined.
levels.theme: Docking bay between ribs that might still breathe

levels.name: Marrow Corridor
levels.description: Tunnels bored through the creature's bones. The marrow was drained decades ago. It's filling back in.
levels.theme: Passages through regenerating bone marrow

levels.name: Vertebral Station
levels.description: Built in the spinal column. Each vertebra is a deck. The spine curves and the station curves with it. Sometimes it straightens.
levels.theme: Station threaded through a spine that still flexes

levels.name: Skull Habitat
levels.description: Living quarters inside the cranium. The brain was removed. Mostly. There are still neural patterns in the bone. Residents report dreams that aren't theirs.
levels.theme: Home inside a skull that still thinks

levels.name: The Heart Chamber
levels.description: The creature's heart. It stopped. It started again. It stopped. The intervals are getting shorter.
levels.theme: Dead heart that won't stay dead

levels.name: Tooth Mine
levels.description: The creature's teeth — mined for exotic minerals. The miners keep finding new teeth growing behind the ones they extract.
levels.theme: Mineral extraction from teeth that keep regrowing

boss.name: The Rib Keeper
boss.description: Parasitic organism living between the ribs — maintaining the heartbeat

weapon.name: Rib Splinter
weapon.description: Shard of the leviathan's rib — vibrates with the heartbeat

armor.name: Intercostal Mesh
armor.description: Woven from the tissue between ribs — elastic and warm

designs.victory_message: The rib keeper detaches. The heartbeat fades. The silence between the ribs is worse than the pulse. Much worse.
designs.defeat_message: You become part of the intercostal tissue. You feel the heartbeat from inside. It's comforting. That's the worst part.

boss.name: The Marrow King
boss.description: Entity gestating in the regenerating marrow — being born from

weapon.name: Marrow Drill
weapon.description: Bores through regenerating bone — the bone screams

armor.name: Calcified Suit
armor.description: Hardened marrow coating — it keeps growing and needs to

designs.victory_message: The marrow king collapses back into the bone. Unborn. The marrow drains. The creature's healing stops. You wonder if that's what you wanted.
designs.defeat_message: The marrow embraces you. You're incorporated into the healing process. You become new bone.

boss.name: The Spine's Memory
boss.description: Residual neural patterns in the vertebrae — the creature's last

weapon.name: Fossilized Fang
weapon.description: Tooth from a creature that ate leviathans — yes, there

armor.name: Spinal Tap Suit
armor.description: Insulates against the neural discharges in the vertebrae

designs.victory_message: The thought finishes. After millions of years, the creature completes its last thought. It was thinking: 'Not dead. Playing dead. Almost ready.'
designs.defeat_message: The nerve pattern incorporates you. You become part of the thought. You think for millions of years.

boss.name: The Bone Shepherd
boss.description: Reanimates the leviathan's skeleton piece by piece — your station

weapon.name: Thought Chisel
weapon.description: Carves ideas into bone — and into minds

armor.name: Cranial Helm
armor.description: Worn inside the skull of a leviathan — dreams slide

designs.victory_message: The bone shepherd scatters. Each fragment finds its original position in the skeleton. The creature is almost reassembled. You leave very, very quickly.
designs.defeat_message: The shepherd adds you to the skeleton. You fit perfectly in the gap between two ribs. You fill a space that was always meant for you.

boss.name: The Dead Heart
boss.description: The leviathan's heart — it died, it restarted, it died

weapon.name: Heartstring Garrote
weapon.description: A chord from the creature's heart — it tightens to

armor.name: Arterial Plating
armor.description: Armor from the creature's arteries — flexes with pressure

designs.victory_message: The heart stops. For real this time. Probably. The silence is total. Then, as you leave, one last beat. Just one. Probably just settling.
designs.defeat_message: The heart wraps around you. You become a clot. You feel every beat. They're getting stronger.

boss.name: The Tooth Fairy
boss.description: Entity that collects the leviathan's shed teeth — and the

weapon.name: Leviathan Molar
weapon.description: A tooth the size of your forearm used as a

armor.name: Enamel Shell
armor.description: Tooth material shaped into armor — nothing bites through it

designs.victory_message: The tooth fairy drops its bag. Teeth scatter everywhere. Among them, human teeth. Recent. You don't count them.
designs.defeat_message: It takes your teeth. Gently. One by one. Then it shows you what it's building with them.

overworld.name: Tartarus Gate
overworld.description: A dead star's gravity well traps everything that enters. Escape velocity is impossible. The only way out is through the singularity.

levels.name: Schwarzschild Station
levels.description: The outermost station. Built by people who thought they could study the dead star safely. They were wrong about 'safely.' They were wrong about 'dead.'
levels.theme: Last outpost before the point of no return

levels.name: Spaghetti Ward
levels.description: Medical facility for treating tidal injuries. Limbs stretched to twice their length. Organs displaced. The treatment is worse than the condition.
levels.theme: Hospital for gravitational distortion injuries

levels.name: Red Shift Corridor
levels.description: Everything here is shifted toward red. Light, sound, time. Your voice drops three octaves. Your heartbeat sounds like a drum. Your thoughts come slowly.
levels.theme: Passage where all frequencies stretch toward red

levels.name: Collapse Cathedral
levels.description: A station built to worship the singularity. The congregation fell in. The sermons continue without them, echoing off the collapsing walls.
levels.theme: Temple to the gravity that consumed the faithful

levels.name: The Singularity
levels.description: The center. Where physics dies. Where space has no direction and time has no flow. Something lives here that doesn't need physics.
levels.theme: Heart of the dead star — where something waits beyond physics

levels.name: Ergosphere Outpost
levels.description: A station spinning in the dead star's rotational frame. Time passes normally here. But normal is relative. The clocks work. They just don't agree.
levels.theme: Spinning station where time is negotiable

boss.name: Dr. Schwarzschild
boss.description: The lead researcher — fell past the event horizon decades

weapon.name: Gravity Spike
weapon.description: Concentrates local gravity into a point — crushes what it

armor.name: Anti-Tidal Suit
armor.description: Distributes gravitational force across your body evenly

designs.victory_message: Dr. Schwarzschild's notes are complete. She stops falling. Her research is the most important paper ever written. Nobody will ever read it.
designs.defeat_message: You join her fall. She offers you a pen. You take notes together. The fall is very long.

boss.name: The Elongated Nurse
boss.description: Medical staff stretched to three times human length by tidal

weapon.description: Surgical saw with a handle stretched to absurd length

armor.name: Compression Bandage Suit
armor.description: Wraps tight enough to resist stretching

designs.defeat_message: The treatment begins. They stretch you to fit the ward. You fit the ward. You'll never fit anywhere else.

boss.name: The Red King
boss.description: Entity that exists only in red-shifted light — you can

weapon.name: Blue Shift Blade
weapon.description: Cuts at the opposite frequency — devastating to red-shifted entities

armor.name: Frequency Lock Vest
armor.description: Keeps your body at normal wavelength

designs.victory_message: Color returns to normal. The corridor remembers blue and green and yellow. The red king fades into frequencies that no longer dominate. It's almost beautiful.
designs.defeat_message: You red-shift completely. Your body stretches into a wavelength that has no end. You become a radio signal broadcasting your last thought forever.

boss.name: The Gravitational Bishop
boss.description: Preaches the gospel of collapse — every sermon pulls the

weapon.name: Cathedral Bell Hammer
weapon.description: The bell fell into the singularity — the hammer remembers

armor.name: Heretic's Plate
armor.description: Blessed by the opposite of whatever the bishop preaches

designs.victory_message: The bishop falls silent. The cathedral holds its shape. The sermons stop echoing. In the silence, you hear the congregation — still falling, still singing.
designs.defeat_message: You join the congregation. The fall is beautiful. The hymns are beautiful. The singularity is beautiful. Everything is beautiful when you stop fighting.

boss.name: The Thing Beyond Physics
boss.description: It doesn't obey laws of nature because it exists where

weapon.name: Law of Thermodynamics (Broken)
weapon.description: A fundamental law of physics, weaponized and violated

armor.name: Reality Anchor Suit
armor.description: Maintains physics around your body when everything else has given

designs.victory_message: You pass through the singularity. On the other side: normal space. Stars. Planets. A comm channel. Home. You don't look back. You can't look back. The singularity ate the concept of 'back.'
designs.defeat_message: The thing welcomes you. Beyond physics, there is no pain. No time. No self. It's not death. It's the thing death is afraid of.

boss.description: Creature that exists in the rotational frame — it spins

weapon.description: Spins faster than the eye can track — angular momentum

armor.name: Counter-Rotation Suit
armor.description: Spins opposite to the frame — cancels the dragging effect

designs.victory_message: The spinning stops. The ergosphere collapses into the dead star. Your inner ear recovers. The clocks finally agree. They all say it's later than you thought.
designs.defeat_message: You spin with the star. Faster. Faster. Time blurs. You become a smear across every moment simultaneously.

overworld.name: Carrion
overworld.description: Decommissioned bioweapons platforms. The weapons were never fully decommissioned. Containment is a polite fiction.

levels.name: Quarantine Dock
levels.description: Triple-sealed entry. Biohazard warnings in twelve languages. The thirteenth language isn't human. It's a warning too.
levels.theme: Entry lock with more warnings than walls

levels.name: Containment Level Alpha
levels.description: The first containment ring. Held stable for decades. Started leaking last week. The leak smells like copper and regret.
levels.theme: Outer containment — cracking after decades

levels.name: Weapons Lab
levels.description: Where they designed the bioweapons. Notes on the desks. The notes describe things that should not be described. You read them anyway.
levels.theme: Research facility for things that should not exist

levels.name: Specimen Vault
levels.description: Cold storage for finished weapons. Rows of canisters. Most are sealed. Some are not. The empty ones are worse than the full ones.
levels.theme: Storage for bioweapons — some canisters are open

levels.name: Patient Zero Chamber
levels.description: The original host. The first infection. They built the station around it because it was too dangerous to move. It's still alive. It's still infectious.
levels.theme: Ground zero — the source of everything contained here

levels.name: Incinerator Bay
levels.description: Where failed experiments are destroyed. The furnace is cold. Something is living in the ashes.
levels.theme: Disposal facility that didn't dispose thoroughly enough

boss.name: The Quarantine Officer
boss.description: Last surviving official — infected years ago, still performing duties,

weapon.name: Decontamination Torch
weapon.description: Burns clean — the only reliable way to sterilize

armor.description: Latest model — rated for everything except what's actually in

designs.victory_message: The quarantine officer stamps your exit paperwork. Approved. Their hand leaves a smear on the form. You don't look at the smear.
designs.defeat_message: Your hazmat suit tears. Such a small tear. You seal it. Too late. The quarantine officer hands you a clipboard. You have duties now.

weapon.description: Seals breaches — temporarily — nothing is permanent here

armor.name: Pressure Suit
armor.description: Maintains internal pressure when containment fails

designs.victory_message: You seal the breach. The containment holds. For now. The cracking sound continues, quieter, deeper in the walls. It's patient.
designs.defeat_message: The failure spreads through you. Every boundary in your body — cell walls, membranes, skin — begins to leak.

weapon.name: Weaponized Cure
weapon.description: The antidote, concentrated and fired at lethal velocity

armor.description: Dr. Carrion's spare — lined with experimental countermeasures

designs.victory_message: Dr. Carrion injects herself with the final antidote. Every weapon in her body deactivates. She ages sixty years in sixty seconds. She whispers: 'Worth it.'

designs.defeat_message: It was you. The whole time. You were the escaped weapon. The real you has been in the canister for years. Sleeping. Dreaming of being free.

boss.description: The original infection — has been alive and evolving for

designs.defeat_message: Patient zero evolves one last time. It becomes you. A perfect copy. Better, actually. It walks out through quarantine. Nobody stops it. It looks healthier than you ever did.

armor.description: Survives incineration — tested thoroughly and involuntarily

designs.victory_message: The phoenix strain doesn't reform. For the first time, the ashes stay ashes. The furnace goes cold. You check the ashes three times. Just ashes. You hope.
designs.defeat_message: You become fuel. The phoenix strain uses your warmth to reform. It thanks you. With your voice. Using your mouth.

overworld.name: Menagerie
overworld.description: Six stations, each a cage for a different alien ecosystem. The containment fields failed decades ago. Now the specimens roam free, adapting, hybridizing, hunting. You are not the apex predator here.

levels.name: Intake Vivarium
levels.description: The quarantine bay where new specimens were catalogued. Claw marks on every surface. Something big broke out of holding cell nine.
levels.theme: aeolian

levels.name: Aquatic Wing
levels.description: Tanks shattered long ago. Salt water knee-deep in every corridor. Bioluminescent predators circle in the dark.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Predator Preserve
levels.description: The large-game enclosure. Artificial savannah gone feral. The grass is tall enough to hide anything.
levels.theme: dorian

levels.name: Hybrid Laboratory
levels.description: Where they spliced ecosystems together. The failures are in jars. The successes are loose.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: Apex Dome
levels.description: The crown exhibit. Built for a single creature they never managed to capture. Something else moved in.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Forgotten Biome
levels.description: A sealed wing no manifest mentions. The ecosystem inside evolved independently for centuries. It has its own food chain now.
levels.theme: whole_tone

armor.description: Layered with shed scales and chitin from a hundred species.

designs.defeat_message: Added to the collection. Exhibit seven-seven-four: human, deceased.

overworld.name: Voltage
overworld.description: Six stations orbiting a gas giant whose atmosphere births continent-sized lightning storms. The stations capture that lightning for power. But the lightning has started striking back. It remembers being caged.

levels.description: The outermost station. Lightning rods the size of skyscrapers drink from the storm below. The air tastes of ozone and copper.

monster_types.description: Silhouettes burned into walls that have learned to peel themselves free. They move in two dimensions.

monster_types.name: Fused Revenant
monster_types.description: A body welded to the machinery by the strike. It drags its station with it.

designs.defeat_message: Your shadow joins the others on the wall. Frozen mid-scream. Permanent.

overworld.name: Cinder System
overworld.description: Everything here burned once. The star flared a century ago, scorching every world and station in its reach. Some things are still burning. Ash drifts between the stations like grey snow. The memory of fire lives in every wall.

levels.name: Ashfall Station
levels.description: The outermost platform. Ash accumulates in drifts against the airlocks. The filtration systems clogged decades ago. Every breath tastes of cinder.
levels.theme: aeolian

levels.name: The Smolder
levels.description: A station that never stopped burning. Low oxygen keeps it at a crawl. Walls glow cherry-red. The heat warps metal and memory alike.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Char Bazaar
levels.description: A trading post built in the burned-out husk of a colony ship. Merchants sell salvage from scorched worlds. Everything is second-hand and singed.
levels.theme: dorian

levels.name: Crucible Deep
levels.description: The innermost station. So close to the scarred star that the hull itself is a kiln. They forge new alloys here from the ash of old worlds.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: The Pyroclast
levels.description: A station carved into an asteroid that is still volcanically active from the flare's impact. Magma seeps through cracks in the floor.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Memory of Flame
levels.description: The burned-out core of the original colony. Holographic records of the flare still play on loop. The ghosts here remember what it was like before everything caught fire.
levels.theme: aeolian

monster_types.description: A figure shaped from compressed ash. It moves like smoke and hits like stone.

monster_types.name: Cinder Mite

designs.defeat_message: The ash closes over you. Another layer of cinder. Another name forgotten.

boss.name: The Slow Burn
boss.description: A fire that has been burning for a hundred years.

monster_types.name: Smolder Shade
monster_types.description: A humanoid heat distortion. It burns whatever it touches but has no substance.

monster_types.name: Coal Crawler
monster_types.description: An arthropod that lives in the perpetual burn. Its carapace is living ember.

monster_types.name: Heat Phantom
monster_types.description: A pocket of superheated air that moves against the ventilation. Walking into it is like walking into a wall of fire.

designs.defeat_message: You become fuel. The Slow Burn thanks you for another decade of life.

boss.description: The colony ship's AI, uploaded into the station's systems when

monster_types.name: Forge Sprite

designs.defeat_message: Ignis adds you to the crucible. You become part of the next blade.

monster_types.name: Obsidian Shard Swarm

boss.name: The Memory of the Flare
boss.description: A holographic recording of the stellar flare that gained sentience

monster_types.description: A recording of someone who died in the flare. They do not know they are dead. Their touch carries the heat of memory.

monster_types.name: Thermal Echo
monster_types.description: A pocket of historically accurate heat. The station remembers the temperature of the flare and recreates it.

armor.name: Thermal Shroud
armor.description: A cloak of heat-resistant fabric from the colony's emergency stores.

designs.victory_message: The recording ends. The colony's last moment finally passes. The ash settles for the first time in a hundred years.
designs.defeat_message: You become part of the recording. Your death plays on loop with all the others.

overworld.name: Solara Prime
overworld.description: The star is dying. Swelling. Turning red. Its golden age is over but the opulent stations refuse to acknowledge it. Crystal chandeliers in ballrooms where the viewports show a sun that fills half the sky. They dance while the photosphere reaches for them.

levels.name: Grand Promenade
levels.description: The outermost station. A luxury boulevard in space. Shop windows display fashions for a civilization with months to live. The mannequins stare at the swelling star.
levels.theme: lydian

levels.name: Solar Observatory
levels.description: Built to study the star. Now it studies the star's death. The astronomers know exactly how long they have. They do not share this information.
levels.theme: aeolian

levels.name: Aristocrat's Refuge
levels.description: The wealthy retreated here when the first evacuation ships left. They brought their art, their wine, their delusions. The refuge is beautiful and doomed.
levels.theme: lydian

levels.name: Throne of Light
levels.description: The Sun King's personal station. Every surface is gold or mirrored. He believes the dying star is his apotheosis — that when it consumes the system, he will be reborn as a god.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Corona Gate
levels.description: The innermost station. Built inside the star's corona. The hull is constantly ablating. They replace it from the outside while the inside pretends nothing is wrong.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: The Last Ballroom
levels.description: They are still dancing. The star fills every window. The music plays. The champagne flows. No one will leave. This is how a golden age ends.
levels.theme: whole_tone

monster_types.name: Promenade Phantom

monster_types.description: The observatory's archives given ghost-form. It whispers stellar death statistics.

designs.defeat_message: You see the number. You understand it. Understanding is the worst part.

monster_types.description: An art-preservation automaton. Its laser restoration tools work equally well on flesh.

monster_types.name: Wine Cellar Specter

designs.defeat_message: You become part of the collection. Lord Aurelian always wanted a human exhibit.

monster_types.description: Couples who died mid-waltz. They still move in perfect time. Their grip is rigor mortis.

monster_types.name: Champagne Specter

designs.defeat_message: You join the dance. The music never stops. The star swells. The ballroom turns to light.

overworld.name: Cygnus Terminal
overworld.description: The star IS dying. Not in metaphor. Not in centuries. Now. Five stations remain. Evacuation ships launch in hours. Time is the real enemy. Every corridor is full of people choosing who lives and who stays.

levels.name: Departure Concourse
levels.description: The main evacuation hub. Thousands of people. Dozens of ships. Not enough seats. The lottery board updates every minute. Riots at gate seven.
levels.theme: aeolian

levels.name: Triage Bay
levels.description: They are choosing who gets medical treatment based on evacuation priority. The wounded who won't make a ship are given comfort meds and a viewport.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Cargo Spine
levels.description: The station's freight corridor. People are hiding in shipping containers, hoping to be loaded onto evacuation ships. Some containers are already sealed. Some were never meant for humans.
levels.theme: dorian

levels.name: Command Deck
levels.description: Where the decisions are made. Captain Vasra runs the evacuation with cold mathematics. Every seat saved is a life. Every delay is a death. She does not sleep.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: Engine Core
levels.description: The station's engines. Running at maximum to maintain orbit against the dying star's gravity. If they fail, the station falls into the photosphere in eleven minutes.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: The Last Dock
levels.description: One ship left. One hundred people. Twenty seats. The airlock is a bottleneck of desperation. Someone has a gun. Several someones.
levels.theme: aeolian

monster_types.name: Triage Automaton
monster_types.description: A medical bot that has run out of supplies. It has begun harvesting from the dead to treat the living.

designs.defeat_message: Dr. Voss marks you for comfort care. The final dose is warm. The viewport is beautiful.

boss.name: Stowaway King
boss.description: He controls the cargo spine. Every container has a price.

monster_types.name: Container Lurker
monster_types.description: Someone who sealed themselves in a container weeks ago. The air ran out. They didn't stay dead.

monster_types.name: Freight Crusher
monster_types.description: A cargo handling bot on automatic. It stacks containers without checking for contents. Human contents.

monster_types.name: Spine Rat
monster_types.description: Vermin that thrived in the cargo holds. The size of dogs now. They ate well on the stowaways who didn't make it.

monster_types.description: The station's defense system projecting hostile targets. You are the target.

designs.defeat_message: Vasra adds your name to the condemned list. Six thousand and one. She will remember you.

boss.description: She controls the last airlock. Twenty seats. One hundred people.

monster_types.name: Armed Evacuee
monster_types.description: Someone with a weapon and no place on the list. Dangerous because they have already accepted death.

monster_types.name: Airlock Ghost
monster_types.description: The spirit of someone who was spaced to make room. They claw at the viewport from outside.

overworld.name: Vanta Black
overworld.description: A system where no star shines. The sun went dark millennia ago. Only station lights push back the absolute void. The dark here is not empty. It is patient, hungry, and it presses against every window like something trying to get in.

levels.name: Lamplight Station
levels.description: The first beacon. Its exterior floods wash light into the void. Maintenance crews report that the dark has gotten closer. The floods used to reach further.
levels.theme: aeolian

levels.name: The Penumbra
levels.description: The transition zone. Half-lit corridors. The lights flicker. In the flicker, things move. When the lights return, nothing is there. But something has changed.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Umbral Processing
levels.description: They tried to study the dark. Sample it. Analyze it. The samples are in sealed containers. Some containers are empty now. The dark is not in them. It is the room.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: The Aphotic Deep
levels.description: Beyond all light. The station's systems provide minimal illumination. Your lamp is the only star in this universe. The dark leans in to look at it.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: Heart of Nothing
levels.description: The center of where the star used to be. There is something here. Not matter. Not energy. An absence so profound it has weight. It pulls.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Last Candle
levels.description: A tiny station. A single room. One light. A woman has been keeping it burning for thirty years. She says if it goes out, the dark wins. She might be right.
levels.theme: aeolian

monster_types.name: Void Angler

boss.description: Thirty years. One candle. She has relit it eleven thousand

monster_types.name: Wax Sentinel
monster_types.description: A figure shaped from thirty years of candle drippings. Sister Lumina prays and it moves. It guards her light.

monster_types.name: Dark Moth
monster_types.description: A creature of the void drawn to the last candle. If it reaches the flame, the dark wins.

weapon.name: Tallow Torch
weapon.description: A crude torch made from thirty years of candle wax.

armor.name: Prayer Shawl
armor.description: Sister Lumina's shawl, imbued with three decades of faith. It

designs.victory_message: The candle burns. Sister Lumina sleeps for the first time in years. The dark presses against the window but it does not enter.
designs.defeat_message: The candle goes out. In the dark, Sister Lumina says: 'I'm sorry. I tried.' Then silence.

overworld.name: Ember Waltz
overworld.description: Binary brown dwarfs dancing toward collision. They orbit each other in a tightening spiral, heating up as they close. The stations between them flee inward but there is nowhere safe. The dance ends in fire.

levels.name: Outer Ring Platform
levels.description: The furthest station from the dwarfs. Radiation is merely dangerous here, not lethal. The evacuation fleet launched from here. The fleet is gone. The people who missed it are not.
levels.theme: aeolian

levels.name: Tidal Lock Station
levels.description: Caught in the gravitational resonance between the two dwarfs. The station rotates to face each star in turn. Day-night cycles last minutes. The crew has stopped sleeping.
levels.theme: dorian

levels.name: Ember Bridge
levels.description: A station suspended in the plasma stream between the two dwarfs. Matter flows past the viewports like a river of fire. The hull sings with the frequency of stellar material.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Danse Macabre
levels.description: The station closest to the point of collision. Built by a cult that worships the coming merger. They call it the Wedding. They intend to be the guests.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: The Collision Point
levels.description: Where the dwarfs will meet. Empty space now, but the gravitational distortions are already visible. Light bends. Time stutters. This is ground zero for a new star.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Frozen Waltz
levels.description: An abandoned station on the system's edge. So far from the dwarfs that it receives no heat. Ice crystals form on every surface. But through the viewport, you can see the two stars embracing.
levels.theme: aeolian

boss.name: Fleet Commander Orsa
boss.description: She ordered the evacuation fleet to launch without her. Someone

monster_types.name: Rad-Burned Straggler
monster_types.description: Someone who missed the fleet. The radiation is killing them slowly. They blame everyone who remained.

monster_types.name: Departure Ghost
monster_types.description: The echo of someone who made it onto a ship. They replay their farewell on loop.

weapon.name: Fleet Beacon Rod
weapon.description: A signal mast from the departure platform. Heavy enough to

designs.victory_message: Orsa turns off her command console. The departure board reads: NO FURTHER DEPARTURES. She already knew.
designs.defeat_message: Orsa logs your arrival. And your departure. She is very thorough with the records of the dead.

monster_types.name: Phase Walker

monster_types.name: Tidal Stress Golem
monster_types.description: Metal warped by gravitational forces until it achieved a crude form. It moves when the tidal forces shift.

weapon.name: Gravitational Lens
weapon.description: A focusing element that bends light and force around it.

designs.victory_message: Pell finally sleeps. The station keeps rotating. Dawn. Dusk. Dawn. Dusk. But no one watches anymore.
designs.defeat_message: The rotation takes you. Dawn becomes dusk becomes dawn becomes nothing.

boss.name: Bridge Warden Koss
boss.description: He maintains the bridge between the dwarfs. He has listened

monster_types.name: Ember Stream Elemental
monster_types.description: A tendril of stellar material that breached the hull. It flows like liquid fire and seeks cooler matter to consume.

monster_types.name: Resonance Phantom
monster_types.description: A crew member vibrated apart by the hull's singing. Their component frequencies haunt the bridge.

weapon.description: A sword tuned to the hull's resonance. It vibrates at
