armor.description: Designed to survive between two stars. The insulation is measured

designs.victory_message: The bridge goes silent. Koss stops vibrating. For one moment, the space between the dwarfs is quiet.
designs.defeat_message: The hull's song enters your bones. You vibrate. You harmonize. You disintegrate into a perfect chord.

boss.name: The Celebrant
boss.description: High priest of the Stellar Wedding cult. She has choreographed

monster_types.name: Wedding Dancer
monster_types.description: A cultist performing their assigned role in the ceremony. They dance toward you with knives and joy.

monster_types.name: Pyre Attendant
monster_types.description: Tends the ceremonial fires that mimic the coming merger. Their devotion makes them immune to their own flames.

monster_types.name: Vow Keeper
monster_types.description: A cultist who has taken a vow of violence. They fulfill it with religious ecstasy.

weapon.name: Ceremonial Flamberge
weapon.description: A wavy-bladed sword used in the wedding ceremony. It is

armor.name: Celebrant's Vestments
armor.description: Ritual robes lined with fire-resistant weave. Beautiful, impractical, and stained

designs.victory_message: The Celebrant's ceremony is interrupted. The Wedding will happen without an audience. The dwarfs do not need witnesses.
designs.defeat_message: You are given a role in the ceremony. The role is sacrifice. The congregation applauds.

boss.name: The Unborn Star
boss.description: Not yet a star. The gravitational and thermal potential of

monster_types.name: Gravity Knot
monster_types.description: A point where space has tied itself. Anything that enters the knot is compressed, stretched, and ejected.

monster_types.name: Pre-Stellar Mass
monster_types.description: Proto-stellar material condensing in the collision zone. It is becoming something. It does not appreciate interference.

weapon.name: Temporal Edge
weapon.description: A blade that exists slightly ahead of the present moment.

armor.name: Dilation Harness
armor.description: Stabilizes your personal timeline in the distortion zone. Without it,

designs.victory_message: The collision point quiets. The dwarfs still dance but the Unborn Star sleeps. The future is delayed, not cancelled.
designs.defeat_message: The Unborn Star claims you as fuel. You become a footnote in stellar nucleosynthesis.

boss.name: The Cold Witness
boss.description: The station's last occupant. She came to the frozen edge

monster_types.name: Ice Phantom
monster_types.description: A frozen crew member who died watching the dwarfs. Their wonder preserved them. Their cold preserves their hostility.

monster_types.name: Frost Crystal Entity
monster_types.description: Ice that grew into complex structures in the thermal dead zone. It thinks in crystalline patterns.

weapon.name: Icicle Spear
weapon.description: Frozen condensation shaped by the thermal dead zone into something

armor.name: Thermal Dead Wrap
armor.description: Insulation from the frozen station. It keeps heat in so

designs.victory_message: The Cold Witness closes her frozen eyes. Through the viewport, the dwarfs continue their dance. She no longer needs to watch.
designs.defeat_message: You freeze. Your last sight is the binary waltz through the viewport. Beautiful. Distant. Indifferent.

overworld.name: Pyre
overworld.description: Everything in this system is on fire. The star, the stations, the people. Some of it is accidental. Some of it is intentional. The Cult of the Eternal Flame worships combustion as the only true state of being. They want to share their faith.

levels.name: Ignition Point
levels.description: The outer station. This is where the Cult recruits. Free food, warm beds, and a sermon about how all matter yearns to oxidize. They are very welcoming. The exits are locked.
levels.theme: dorian

levels.name: The Kiln
levels.description: Where the Cult tempers its faithful. Endurance through fire. Those who survive are promoted. Those who don't are fuel. The distinction is theological.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Combustion Cathedral
levels.description: The Cult's house of worship. The altar is a perpetual bonfire. The pews face the flames. The sermons are delivered from within the fire. The High Cinder's voice comes from everywhere.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: Fuel Reserves
levels.description: The station's fuel storage. The Cult sees it as a sacrament. Tanks of liquid accelerant line the corridors like wine barrels in a cellar. One spark and the system loses a station.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: The Crucible of Souls
levels.description: The inner sanctum. Where the High Cinder performs the Final Combustion — the ritual that supposedly releases the soul through fire. The walls are covered in the names of the burned.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: Cold Shrine
levels.description: A hidden station. The Cult's heretics — those who believe fire should be controlled, not worshipped. They maintain a single room at freezing temperature. An act of defiance in a burning system.
levels.theme: aeolian

boss.name: Brother Kindling
boss.description: The recruiter. Warm smile, warm handshake, warm philosophy. He genuinely

monster_types.name: New Convert
monster_types.description: Recently indoctrinated. Carrying a torch and a zealot's certainty. They want to share the warmth.

monster_types.name: Smoke Wraith
monster_types.description: The accumulated smoke of a thousand prayer candles given form. It chokes and blinds.

weapon.name: Convert's Torch

designs.defeat_message: Brother Kindling lights your pyre. He sings a hymn. It is, he assures you, beautiful on the other side.

boss.name: The Tempered
boss.description: A cultist who survived the Kiln seven times. Their skin

monster_types.description: A cultist mid-tempering. Their robes are on fire. They don't notice. They notice you.

monster_types.name: Coal Elemental
monster_types.description: The burning coal bed given purpose. It rises in humanoid form, shedding embers with every step.

monster_types.name: Ash Pit Crawler
monster_types.description: Something in the ash pits. The Cult says they're the unworthy. They crawl out sometimes.

weapon.name: Kiln Tongs
weapon.description: Massive tongs used to place subjects in the Kiln. They

armor.description: Ceramic armor baked in the Kiln itself. Harder than steel.

designs.defeat_message: The Kiln accepts you. Seven times, they said. You do not survive the first.

boss.description: They speak from within the altar fire. No one has

monster_types.description: A worshipper who will not leave their seat. They pray and they burn and they reach for passersby.

monster_types.name: Altar Flame
monster_types.description: A tongue of sacred fire that detaches from the bonfire and hunts heretics through the nave.

monster_types.name: Choir of Cinders
monster_types.description: The remains of the cathedral choir. They still sing. The sound carries heat.

armor.description: A vestment of the inner order. The fabric is interwoven

designs.defeat_message: The congregation welcomes you. The altar fire grows. Your screams are mistaken for hymns.

boss.description: He guards the fuel reserves. To the Cult, this is

monster_types.description: An automaton designed to prevent fuel theft. The Cult reprogrammed it to prevent fuel waste. Using fuel to burn heretics is not waste.

boss.description: The Cult's ultimate expression. A fire started in the Crucible

monster_types.description: The ashen remains of a soul-burned cultist. They walk, they reach, they remember burning.

monster_types.name: Crucible Keeper
monster_types.description: A cultist who tends the Final Flame. They feed it. They speak to it. It speaks back.

boss.description: Leader of the heretics. A former High Cinder who touched

monster_types.description: Heretics who rejected fire. They fight with ice and desperation.

monster_types.name: Frost Construct
monster_types.description: A guardian built from frozen condensation. It exists only because the cooling systems keep running.

designs.defeat_message: The Cult finds the Cold Shrine. The cooling systems fail. The heresy ends in fire, as the Cult always promised.

overworld.name: Cradle of Ash
overworld.description: What remains after a supernova. Stations built in the expanding debris shell. New elements forged in the explosion drift like seeds through the wreckage. This is a graveyard and a nursery. Death made something new here.

levels.name: Shell Outpost
levels.description: Built on the inner edge of the debris shell. Supernova remnant material drifts past the viewports — incandescent gas and newborn elements. The view would be beautiful if it weren't radioactive.
levels.theme: lydian

levels.name: Forge of Novae
levels.description: A refinery station processing supernova-forged elements. Isotopes that don't exist anywhere else. The periodic table has new entries here, and some of them are unstable.
levels.theme: dorian

levels.name: The Nursery
levels.description: Where new stars are forming from the compressed debris. Protostars glow like embers in the ash. The stations here study birth in the aftermath of death.
levels.theme: lydian

levels.name: Core Fragment
levels.description: A chunk of the dead star's core, drifting through the debris field. The station is bolted to it. The fragment is still hot. It will be hot for ten thousand years.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Genesis Engine
levels.description: Built to catalyze star formation from the debris. It worked too well. The protostar it ignited is growing faster than projected. The station cannot detach.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: Ash Garden
levels.description: A station where the debris has been cultivated into something deliberate. New minerals form crystalline structures. Life is emerging from the supernova's remains. It is alien and fragile and determined.
levels.theme: whole_tone

monster_types.description: A chunk of supernova remnant that has achieved motility through electromagnetic charge. It tumbles through corridors, crushing what it hits.

monster_types.description: A construct of nova-forged metal. Its composition changes as it moves, adapting to whatever damages it.

monster_types.description: The spinning force of the refinement process given sentience. It pulls everything toward its center.

monster_types.name: Cascade Elemental

monster_types.description: A chunk of condensing gas and dust on its way to becoming a star. It burns with potential.

monster_types.name: Nebula Wisp
monster_types.description: A tendril of glowing gas that drifts through the nursery. Beautiful and suffocating.

monster_types.description: A creature that burrows through neutron-dense material. Its metabolism is nuclear. Its waste products are lethal.

monster_types.name: Thermal Revenant
monster_types.description: The heat of the dead core given shape. Ten thousand years of cooling and it is still hot enough to melt steel.

boss.name: The First Bloom
boss.description: Life that evolved from supernova debris. Not carbon-based. Not silicon-based.

monster_types.name: Crystal Tendril
monster_types.description: A growth of nova-born mineral that reaches for organic matter. It does not understand that contact is lethal.

monster_types.name: Ash Blossom
monster_types.description: A flower made of compressed supernova ash. Its pollen is mildly radioactive. Its beauty is undeniable.

designs.defeat_message: The First Bloom embraces you. Its alien chemistry rewrites your own. You become something new, something that was never meant to be.

overworld.name: Perihelion
overworld.description: Dangerously close orbit around a neutron star. The gravitational field crushes metal. The magnetic field strips atoms. The radiation rewrites DNA. Time itself runs slower here. The stations exist because someone decided that studying a dead god was worth dying for.

levels.name: Approach Vector
levels.description: The outermost station. Already the effects are visible — clocks run slow, metal groans under tidal stress, the stars outside are blue-shifted. This is where courage becomes stupidity.
levels.theme: aeolian

levels.name: Magnetar Ring
levels.description: A station orbiting within the neutron star's magnetic field. Unshielded metal becomes a projectile. Hair stands on end. Electronics fail. Analog instruments only.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Radiation Reef
levels.description: The neutron star's emission beam sweeps through this area every 1.3 seconds. The station rotates to keep its shielded side facing the beam. When the rotation fails, everything in line of sight dies.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: Tidal Lock Lab
levels.description: Where they study gravitational effects. The difference in gravity between your head and your feet is measurable. Tall people don't last long here.
levels.theme: phrygian

levels.name: Surface Approach
levels.description: Twenty kilometers above the neutron star's surface. The station is a speck above a dead god. The surface glows with X-rays. A teaspoon of the material below weighs a billion tons.
levels.theme: locrian

levels.name: The Lighthouse
levels.description: A station built in the neutron star's emission beam. It uses the beam as a power source. It is the most dangerous inhabited structure in the known universe. The crew calls it home.
levels.theme: aeolian

monster_types.description: A piece of the station torn loose by gravitational stress. It orbits the corridor, gaining speed.

designs.defeat_message: Magnos pulls. Every piece of metal on your body obeys him, not you. The field does the rest.

monster_types.name: Pulse Tick
monster_types.description: A creature that lives in the 1.3-second gap between beams. It hunts in the shadow and hides when the light comes.

overworld.name: Redshift
overworld.description: Everything in this system is moving away from everything else. Stations recede as you approach. Communication redshifts into noise. The universe is running away from you.

overworld.name: Dominion
overworld.description: A military system locked down after a war that everyone lost. Automated defenses still fighting. No one left to surrender to.

boss.description: Archivist rebuilding your past as a gilded cage.

weapon.description: A blade that severs attachment. Each cut is a goodbye.

armor.name: Present Tense Armor
armor.description: Armor anchored to now. Memories slide off it.

overworld.description: Every station gleams with wealth. Every exit is locked. The richest system in space is a prison. Money can't buy freedom when freedom isn't for sale.

levels.description: The station flipped. Or you flipped. Same thing. Blood rushes to your head, or your feet, or whatever direction your head is currently pointing.
levels.theme: vertigo_inversion

levels.name: Gravity Well
levels.description: Every direction is down. You fall toward the center of a room and can't leave because leaving means falling up.
levels.theme: vertigo_well

levels.name: The Fulcrum
levels.description: The center of the station's gravity madness. Here, all directions are down simultaneously. The only way to stand is to fall in every direction at once.
levels.theme: vertigo_fulcrum

levels.name: Level Ground
levels.description: One room where gravity works normally. The most disorienting room in the station, because you've forgotten what normal feels like.
levels.theme: vertigo_level

designs.defeat_message: The spin never stops. You become part of the carousel. Around and around.

boss.name: Inverter Magistrate Flip
boss.description: Deck-flipping judge reversing all spatial law.

designs.defeat_message: Inverted permanently. You see the world upside down and can't remember which way was right.

boss.name: Singularity Warden Nadir
boss.description: Gravity-well keeper pulling everything to center-mass.

weapon.name: Escape Velocity
weapon.description: A hammer that swings with enough force to break orbit.

armor.name: Anti-Gravity Frame
armor.description: Armor that pushes back. The well can't hold you.

designs.victory_message: The well releases. Gravity remembers its manners. Things fall one way again.
designs.defeat_message: The well pulls you to the center and holds you. You float in the middle of a room, forever falling, never landing.

boss.name: The Absolute Down
boss.description: Gravity singularity pulling from every direction at once.

weapon.name: True North

designs.victory_message: The fulcrum stabilizes. Gravity flows one way. Down is down. Up is up. The simplest miracle in the universe.
designs.defeat_message: All directions become down. You fall into yourself. The fulcrum adds your mass to its own.

boss.name: Equilibrium Ghost
boss.description: Phantom of normalcy haunting the one stable room.

weapon.name: Spirit Level
weapon.description: A blade as flat and true as a calm sea.

armor.name: Flat-Footed Plate
armor.description: Armor designed for level ground. Incredibly effective in the one

designs.victory_message: Level ground holds. One room of sanity in a mad station. It's enough.
designs.defeat_message: Normal gravity felt wrong after so long without it. You stumbled. You fell. One foot.

overworld.name: Tesseract
overworld.description: Four-dimensional stations. Rooms connect to rooms that shouldn't exist. Corridors loop through themselves. Geometry has surrendered.

levels.name: Third-Wall Gallery
levels.description: Three-dimensional space is the floor plan. The fourth dimension is the architecture. You can see rooms from angles that don't exist.
levels.theme: tesseract_gallery

levels.name: Hypercube Atrium
levels.description: A room inside a room inside the first room. You can see yourself through walls that face inward from outside.
levels.theme: tesseract_atrium

levels.name: Klein Corridor
levels.description: A hallway with one surface. Inside is outside. You walk on the ceiling from below while standing on the floor from above.
levels.theme: tesseract_klein

levels.name: Manifold Junction
levels.description: Where multiple dimensions of the station intersect. Doors open to rooms on different planes of existence. Choose wrong and you're somewhere that doesn't have a where.
levels.theme: tesseract_manifold

levels.name: The Unfolded Core
levels.description: The tesseract opened. Four-dimensional space laid flat. You can see every room from every angle at once. It's too much. It's exactly enough.
levels.theme: tesseract_core

levels.name: Flatland Cell
levels.description: A room with only two dimensions. Length and width. No height. You're pressed flat and alive. It's like being a drawing that can think.
levels.theme: tesseract_flat

boss.name: Curator Polytope
boss.description: Gallery keeper arranging exhibits across impossible angles.

designs.defeat_message: Folded into a dimension you can't see. You still exist. You just can't find yourself.

boss.name: Nesting Lord Recursion
boss.description: Self-containing entity living inside its own interior.

weapon.description: Perfectly, aggressively flat. One dimension of sharpness. The tesseract can't

armor.name: Cubic Defense
armor.description: Armor with exactly six sides. Boring. Reliable. Geometrically sound.

designs.victory_message: The hypercube unfolds to a cube. Six sides. Comprehensible. Safe.
designs.defeat_message: Nested inside yourself. A room within a room within you within the room.

boss.name: Moebius Warden Klein
boss.description: One-sided surface sentinel patrolling infinite topology.

weapon.name: Bilateral Blade
weapon.description: A sword with two distinct sides. In a Klein corridor,

armor.name: Oriented Armor
armor.description: Armor with a definite inside and outside. On a Klein

designs.victory_message: The Klein corridor gains a second side. Inside becomes inside. Outside stays out.
designs.defeat_message: You walk the single surface forever. Inside and outside are the same. You are the corridor.

boss.name: Junction Sovereign Riemann
boss.description: Manifold king commanding intersections between realities.

weapon.name: Axis Lock

armor.name: Dimension Anchor
armor.description: Armor pinned to three-dimensional space with mathematical precision. The fourth

designs.victory_message: The manifold simplifies. Doors lead where they should. Rooms contain only themselves.
designs.defeat_message: You opened the wrong door. The room on the other side doesn't have dimensions you can survive in.

boss.name: The Hypersphere
boss.description: Infinite-faced four-dimensional sphere beyond mortal comprehension.

weapon.name: Simplicity
weapon.description: A perfectly straight stick. No curves. No angles. One dimension

armor.name: Flatland Fortress
armor.description: Armor that exists in exactly three dimensions and refuses to

designs.victory_message: The tesseract folds down to three dimensions. The Hypersphere collapses into a sphere. Geometry remembers its place.
designs.defeat_message: You understood it. For one moment, you saw in four dimensions. Your brain could not return to three.

boss.name: Flatlord Euclid
boss.description: Two-dimensional despot crushing depth from existence.

weapon.name: Height
weapon.description: A weapon from the third dimension. To flatland, it's incomprehensible

armor.name: Depth Shield
armor.description: A shield with thickness. In two dimensions, it's impenetrable.

designs.victory_message: The cell gains depth. Two dimensions become three. You stand up for the first time.
designs.defeat_message: Compressed to two dimensions. You exist. You just can't reach anything above or below you. There is no above or below.

overworld.name: Leviathan Wake
overworld.description: The bones that were Scrimshaw were just one finger. The full creature spans systems. It's waking up. The stations on its body are parasites it's about to scratch.

levels.name: Dermal Station
levels.description: The station is built on skin. It stretches when the creature shifts. The walls are warm and they breathe.
levels.theme: leviathan_dermal

levels.name: Vascular Transit
levels.description: Corridors that pulse. You're inside a vein. The current pushes you forward. The creature's heartbeat is the floor shaking every seven seconds.
levels.theme: leviathan_vascular

levels.name: Marrow Depths
levels.description: Inside the bones now. The same bones that Scrimshaw was built on, but these are alive. They creak with growth.
levels.theme: leviathan_marrow

levels.name: Neural Cluster
levels.description: The creature's nervous system. Thoughts the size of planets move through cables of nerve fiber. You are an irritation. It's starting to notice.
levels.theme: leviathan_neural

levels.name: The Waking Eye
levels.description: It opens. The eye is a station. The pupil is a door. Behind it: a mind that has slept since before humanity discovered fire. It's awake. It sees you.
levels.theme: leviathan_eye

levels.name: Symbiont Bay
levels.description: A station that has been living on the creature so long it's become part of it. Half metal, half meat. The residents don't know which they are anymore.
levels.theme: leviathan_symbiont

boss.name: Dermal Warden Chitin
boss.description: Skin-station immune guardian rejecting all parasites.

weapon.name: Surgeon's Blade
weapon.description: A scalpel scaled up to a sword. Cuts flesh with

armor.description: Armor grown from the creature's own chitin. It recognizes you

designs.victory_message: The skin calms. The creature accepts your presence. For now.
designs.defeat_message: Scratched off like a flea. The creature barely noticed.

boss.name: Heartbeat Overseer Pulse
boss.description: Vascular enforcer riding the creature's circulatory tide.

weapon.name: Anticoagulant Edge
weapon.description: A blade that keeps wounds open. The creature can't clot

armor.name: Platelet Armor
armor.description: Armor made of the creature's own clotting agents. Heals as

designs.defeat_message: Flushed out through a vein. Expelled. The creature's circulation treated you like waste.

boss.name: Ossuary Keeper Calcium
boss.description: Bone-growing sentinel fossilizing intruders alive.

weapon.name: Bone Saw
weapon.description: Cuts through the framework of the universe's largest living thing.

armor.name: Marrow-Forged Mail
armor.description: Armor grown in the creature's bones. Hard as the deepest

designs.victory_message: The bones settle. Growth pauses. The creature's skeleton holds still.
designs.defeat_message: Entombed in growing bone. Fossilized alive in the skeleton of a god.

boss.name: Synapse Lord Cortex
boss.description: Neural cluster commander directing continent-sized thoughts.

weapon.name: Anesthesia Lance
weapon.description: A spear tipped with numbness. Where it strikes, the creature

armor.name: Insulation Weave
armor.description: Armor that blocks neural signals. The creature's thoughts can't reach

designs.victory_message: The neural cluster dims. The creature's attention drifts. You're forgotten. That's survival.
designs.defeat_message: The creature thought about you. One thought. It was enough. You were unmade by consideration.

boss.name: The Awakened Mind
boss.description: Eon-sleeping planetary consciousness now fully aware of you.

weapon.name: The Blind Spot
weapon.description: A dagger that strikes where the eye can't see. Every

armor.description: Armor wired into the creature's visual system. It sees through

designs.victory_message: The eye closes. Not in death — in peace. The Leviathan returns to sleep, and in its dreams, it remembers a small thing that stood inside its eye and refused to be afraid.
designs.defeat_message: The eye focused. The full weight of a planetary consciousness looked at you. You were not big enough to be seen. You ceased to exist from its perspective. That was enough.

boss.name: Symbiont Patriarch Graft
boss.description: Half-metal half-meat elder fused to the creature's body.

weapon.name: Separation Scalpel
weapon.description: A blade that cuts metal from meat. Severs the symbiosis.

armor.name: Hybrid Hide
armor.description: Armor that's half machine, half organism. It argues with itself

designs.victory_message: Metal and meat separate. The symbionts choose their side. Both survive.
designs.defeat_message: The symbiosis completed. You became part of the station. The station is part of the creature. You are a cell in a god.

overworld.name: Requiem
overworld.description: The last system. Every station is a memorial. Every corridor is a eulogy. The journey ends where all journeys end — at the place where someone remembers you were here.

levels.name: Hall of Names
levels.description: Every wall is inscribed. Every name is someone who came before you. Some you recognize. Most you don't. All of them mattered.
levels.theme: requiem_names

levels.name: Echo Nave
levels.description: A cathedral in space. Sound carries forever here. Every footstep joins the echoes of everyone who walked before.
levels.theme: requiem_nave

levels.name: The Cenotaph
levels.description: A tomb for those whose bodies were never found. The empty coffins are the heaviest things you've ever carried.
levels.theme: requiem_cenotaph

levels.name: Vigil Bridge
levels.description: The bridge between remembering and forgetting. Candles that never go out line the railings. Each one is a life.
levels.theme: requiem_vigil

levels.name: The Last Threshold
levels.description: The final room. The end of the journey. No enemies here except the question: was it enough?
levels.theme: requiem_threshold

levels.name: The Quiet Room
levels.description: A room with no purpose except to be still. After fifty systems, you've earned the silence.
levels.theme: requiem_quiet

boss.name: The Keeper of Names
boss.description: Wall-inscriber guarding the hall of the remembered.

weapon.name: Epitaph
weapon.description: A blade that writes as it cuts. Every wound is

armor.name: Mourning Veil
armor.description: Armor made of grief. Surprisingly strong. Grief usually is.

designs.victory_message: Your name joins the wall. Not the brightest. Not the largest. But there.
designs.defeat_message: Your name was never inscribed. The wall is for those who finished the journey.

boss.name: Choirmaster Resonance
boss.description: Cathedral conductor harmonizing the voices of the dead.

weapon.name: Resonance
weapon.description: A tuning fork the size of a sword. Strikes the

armor.name: Choir Robe
armor.description: Armor woven from sustained notes. Sound wraps around you protectively.

designs.victory_message: Your voice joins the nave. One more note in an eternal chord.
designs.defeat_message: The echoes drown you out. Your voice is lost in the sound of everyone who came before.

boss.name: The Hollow Steward
boss.description: Empty-tomb guardian holding space for the never-returned.

weapon.name: Presence
weapon.description: A weapon that fills empty space. Strikes with the weight

armor.name: Placeholder Armor
armor.description: Armor that stands in for absent friends. You wear everyone

designs.victory_message: The cenotaph fills. Not with a body — with a memory. That's enough. That was always enough.
designs.defeat_message: An empty coffin with your measurements. It was always waiting for you.

boss.name: Candle Warden Perpetua
boss.description: Eternal vigil-keeper tending flames for every lost soul.

weapon.name: Candlelight
weapon.description: A rapier that glows with the light of every candle

armor.name: Vigil Cloak
armor.description: Armor for the long watch. Warm enough for the cold

designs.victory_message: The candles brighten. One more joins them. Yours. It will burn as long as someone remembers.
designs.defeat_message: The candles go out one by one. Yours was the last. The bridge goes dark.

boss.name: The Memory of Everything
boss.description: Accumulated recollection of every system you ever crossed.

weapon.name: The Journey
weapon.description: Not a weapon. A record. Every swing replays a moment

armor.name: Everything You've Carried
armor.description: Armor made from every lesson, every scar, every moment of

designs.victory_message: It remembers. You remember. The journey mattered. Not because of what waited at the end, but because of what you became on the way. The last threshold opens — not to another station, not to another system, but to whatever comes after. You step through. The door closes behind you. Somewhere, on the Hall of Names, a new inscription appears. It's yours.
designs.defeat_message: You forgot. Not the names, not the places — you forgot why it mattered. The Memory dissolves, and so do you. The threshold closes. Another traveler will come. Maybe they'll remember.

boss.name: The Last Silence
boss.description: Final question echoing in the stillness after everything.

weapon.name: Rest
weapon.description: A weapon you don't have to swing. Its presence is

armor.description: Armor that makes no sound. After fifty systems of noise,

designs.victory_message: Silence. Not empty silence — full silence. The silence after a story well told. You sit down. You've earned it.
designs.defeat_message: The quiet room asks nothing. You give nothing. The journey ends not with a bang or a whimper, but with a question you couldn't answer.

strings.title: SCAPEGRACE
strings.subtitle: A journey across fifty star systems
intro: You are a salvager on the edge of known space.
Something is calling from deeper in the void.
Each star system is a chain of stations — each one
more dangerous than the last. Clear them all,
or die trying in the dark between stars.
